mer 'dod pa'i rgyal po lcags kyu 'dzin pa'o/ / sa man+ta bud+dhe bh+yo oṃ ṭak+ki hūm̐ dzaḥkha ti thod le kor/ dang ni btsag la yang*/ rdo rje lcags kyu'i gzugs byas la/ sbyor ba las/ / zla ba gzas zin pa'i dus su/ nye bar chags dus su/ / lcags kyu khar bcug nas ni bsgrub par bya/ /ming gong gi rdzas las byas pa'i lcags kyu des gang dgug pa'i ni bris pa tsam gyis dang / / brgya ni gsal bar bzlas pa yis/ / sred med/ skra ldan gnas rlung lha/ med lha'i dbang po dbang phyug drag /chung mar bcas pa dgug par bya/ /dam 'gugs pa las mi 'da' bas/ tshig lcags kyu rdo rje zhes bya'i ting nge 'dzin to// // spyi'i bsam gtan bsam gtan dang*/ sngags dang ting 'dzin 'di dpa' bo gcig pa la yang sbyor mod mi gtso bo ( 'o ) gnas/ /rang gi rig ma skyes bu khro bo yab yum/ bdag / ye shes dgug pa'i gnas su gzung bar bya/ /thub pa khugs pa las/ gzhan du mi 'gyur ro/ /na maḥs man+ta bud+dha nāṃ/ na maḥs man+ta dhārmā nāṃ/ na maḥs man+ta saṃ gha nāṃ/ steng gi gtsug tor 'khor lo sgyur ba'i rgyal po 'khor lo thogs pas gtso byas pa'i khro bo bcu bsgoms la gzhan gyi rig sngags kyang bzlog par bya oṃ gdugs dkar po can/ si tā ta pa tre oṃ bi dri ma med pa/ ma la/ oṃ shang ka ra/ 'byung gnas tshul ma yin pa rlag par byed pa'irdo rje oṃ pra t+yaṅgi ra badz+ra u gtsug tor/ ṣ+ṇi ṣa tsakra 'khor lo/ bar+t+ti sgyur ba/ sarba thams cad/ yan+t+ra 'phrul 'khor/ man+t+ra sngags| mu la rtsa ba'i las/ kar+m+ma bhan+dha chings nāṃ tā zlog ḍa naṃ ki phur bu'i/ la naṃ ba ma ma bdag la byas na/ kri te ye gal te/ na kā+ai na 'ga' zhig gis byas na/ tsi ta kri taṃ tat+ta thams cad/ sarban+tu ts+tshin+dha ts+tshin+dha gtubs gnyis/ bhin+dha bhin+dha/ phug cig gnyis/ tsi ri phye mar gyis shig gnyis/ tsi ri gi ri gi ri gyis shig gnyis/ mā ra mā ra sod cig gnyis/ hūṃ hūṃ hūṃ hūṃ hūṃ hūṃ

khro bo bcu bskyed| hūṃ hūṃ hūṃ hūṃ/ phaṭa phaṭa phaṭa/ mthu byad la sogs pa las/ bdag nyid bsrung ba'i sbyor ba las/ / gzhan gyis byas pa'i mnan pa sogs/ sbyor ba rgyud sogs phyi'i sbyor ba gzugs sgyur/ gzhig pa la/ / bsrung ba'i 'khor lo dpung par la gdags so/ / rig mas 'khyud byas na/ /'jig rten gsum gyis 'da' mi nus/ khro bo chen po'i gtsug tor| 'khor lo sgyur ba'i rgyal po/ rdo rje zhes bya ba'i ting nge 'dzin to// // gnas dben pa'am nags tshal nyid du'ang*/ / 'grub bam mi 'grub kyi/ yid gnyis thams cad rnam spangs la/ /rnal 'byor mchog ni 'di bsgrub na/ /thub pa 'grub pa las/ gzhan du mi 'gyur ro/ khro bo chen pa bcu 'i gtsug tor/ 'khor lo sgyur ba 'i snying po'i sngags la 'jug pa'i rdo rje zhes bya ba'i le'u ste sho lo ka brgya brgyad cu rtsa gsum bzhugs so// bzhi pa'o// //de nas bcom ston pa po/ ldan rdo rje can/ / de kun 'gro'i dbang phyug sems can kun gyi snying ngam sems de yang rang rig gi ye shes yin la rdo rje 'dzin pa rang rig yin pas/ la bzhugs | | kun mkhyen pa'i/ ye shes las byung ba/ / rigs lnga'i dkyil 'khor/ yang dag rab tu nges par byed/ / mi bskyod pa'i/ sangs rgyas rnam snang gzugs brnyan rang ste gzhal yas khang*/ bsgoms te/ /rdo rje mi bskyod pa'i dam tshig sems dpas 'og ma la yang 'gre/ sems dpa' rab bsgom bya/ /sangs rgyas gzugs gzhal yas khang 'og ma la 'gre/ brnyan rab bsgoms nas/ /rdo rje rnam snang rnam snang gi dam tshig sems dpa' 'og ma la yang 'gre| dran par bya/ /sangs rgyas gzugs brnyan rab bsgoms te/ /rdo rje nyi ma rtog pa'i mun pa 'joms pa/ rab bsgom bya/ /sangs rgyas gzugs su rab bsgoms nas | | 'dod chags rdo rje rnam par bsgom/ /sems can zer yang sangs rgyas/ gzugs brnyan de sku/ rnam bsgoms te/ /rta yi don yod rab bsgom bya/

/ sangs rgyas gzugs brnyan las byung ba'i/ /dkyil bud+dha'i gzhal yas khang du bsdu ba/ 'khor lnga po/ rnams kyi gtso bo lnga po/ ni rtag bsgom bya/ / bsdus pa dkyil 'khor gyi dbang du byas na rigs lnga po/ hūm̐ bruṃ aṃ dz+ri ཾ khaṃ thams cad rnams kyi sngags 'di yis/ /snying khar dam tshig gi 'khor lo/ ye shes sems dpa'i/ gnas su de'i snying khar ting nge 'dzin sems dpa'i/ dgod | | de dag las 'od zer spros te ye shes kyi 'khor lo/ sems dpar rab sbyor bas | | sangs rgyas byang chub 'thob bar 'gyur/ / snying khar nyi ma'i steng du hūm̐ la sogs pa rang gi 'dis kyang gong gi sems dpa' sum brtsegs rang gsal bar bstan sngags kyi/ yi ge rdzogs pa dang*/ /phyag rgya sa bon las/ dang ni phyag mtshan brtag / so sor gyur te de dag las rang gi sa bon tsam gyi yi ge bkod la de las ye shes sems dpa' tshon gang bar gyur pa de la so so'i ye shes sems dpa'i snying khar so so'i sngags la phyag mtshan las yi ge las mtshon ting nge 'dzin sems dpa' de ltar 'od/ spro dang bsdu ba byas pa ni/ /dkyil 'khor rnams kyi 'byung gnas nyid/ /sgra la rnam gsum shes byas nas/ / yid du 'ong ba dang mi 'ong ba tha mal pa/ lha rnams mi bskyod pa 'khor dang bcas pa/ la ni dbul bar bya/ / sgra gsum po/ de nyid bcom ldan rdo rje can/ /rdo rje sems dpa' chen po'i ngo bo yin pas/ grags chen po/ / gzugs gsum po/ la rnam gsum shes byas nas/ /lha rnams rnam snang 'khor dang bcas pa la ni dbul bar bya/ /de nyid bcom ldan gzugs gsum po/ rgyal po ni/ /rdo rje rnam snang mnga' bdag nyid/ /dri la rnam gsum shes byas nas/ lha rnams la ni dbul bar bya/ /de nyid bcom ldan sangs rgyas ni/ /rin chen phung por 'dod pa'i don kun sgrub par grags / rab tu grags/ /ro la rnam gsum rnam shes nas/ /lha rnams la ni dbul bar bya/ /de nyid bcom ldan 'dod chags nyid/

/rdo rje chos ni de bzhin gshegs/ /reg la rnam gsum rnam shes nas/ /lha rnams la ni dbul bar bya/ /de nyid bcom ldan sna tshogs pa/ /don yod 'bras bu ster la yang mchod la de nas gau rī la sogs pa yang dgug gzhug bya'o/ / ba po/ /bsrung ba'i dam khro bcu'i bsrung ba byas pa las mi 'da' bar 'khor lo'i/ tshig dbus gnas pa'i/ / bsdus pa'i/ dkyil 'khor lnga ni bsgom par bya/ / re re yang lnga'i ngo bo yin pas mi bskyod pa la sogs pa re re yang bzhi bzhis bskor bas lnga lnga'i bdag nyid rdzogs sangs rgyas/ /ye shes lnga lnga'i ngo bo rgyal ba/ ni rnam par bsgom/ /'dod pa'i gzhal yas khang gi nang na gzugs rdo rje la sogs pa/ yon tan lnga dang ldan/ /'od zer lnga/ sna tshogs kun tu khyab/ /sna 'od zer/ tshogs kyis/ las bzhi/ ni byed par brjod/ / rigs lnga po/ thams cad bsdus pa'i dkyil 'khor ni/ / 'bri tsam na rdul tshon nyi shu rtsa lnga'i dbye ba yis/ /rdul dkyil 'khor lnga'i bye brag gis rdul tshon dkar po la sogs pa re res gtso bo byas pa'i tshon lnga tshon gyis kyang bri bar bya/ sangs rgyas lnga yi rang bzhin gyis/ / sbyang gzhi phung po lngar ni rab tu grags | | sangs rgyas mi bskyod pa'i bsdus pa'i dkyil 'khor gyi dbang du byas nas mi bskyod pa dbus na/ mgon po'i dkyil 'khor ni/ /shar gyi char ni rab tu grags/ /g.yas su rdo rje nyi ma'o/ /nub tu 'dod chags rdo rje yi/ /byang du rta yi rgyal po yi/ / dbus su rdo rje sems dpa' yi/ /shar du dkar po chen gtso bo'i bye brag gis kha dog dbye ba/ po kha dog yi/ /lhor ni ser mi bskyod pa'i dbang du byas na/ po yang dag ldan/ / dmar po nub kyi cha nyid du'o/ /btsod ljang khu/ ni byang du yang dag ldan/ / mtshams kyi cha ni thams cad dang*/ /sgo yi logs dang ya phubs su/ /rdo rje rin chen rnams kyis brgyan/ /sna tshogs 'od zer/ snang ba rnams kyis mdzes/

/sangs rgyas mgon po rigs lnga car gyi dkyil 'khor de na yod kyang gang gis gtso byas pa de'i dkyil 'khor/ gang nyid kyi/ / gang yangarung ba dkyil 'khor kyi/ dbus su gnas par/ gyur pa ni/ /de nyid kyi ni dkyil 'khor brjod/ / dkyil/ snying po nges tshig yongs 'khor/ bzung te 'dus pa| dkyil 'khor te/ / rigs so sor phye na dkyil 'khor re re bsgoms pa so so'i lha dgu'i bdag nyid can/ 'am/ /yang na bsdus pa'i dkyil 'khor ro/ / de nyid bshad pa/ brgyad brgyad lha mo/ dbus su gnas pa bsdus pa rab/ 'am/ /yang na mtshams ma bor bas 'bri| nyi shu rtsa lnga ru/ /gang tshe mi bskyod pa'i/ dkyil 'khor bsdus pa yi/ /sgor ni lcags kyu zhags pa dang*/ /lcags sgrog de bzhin rdo rje sa mtshan pa'i dril bu/ nyid/ / 'jug pa'i sgo srung dgod par bya/ /bcom ldan 'das kyis bsdus pa chen po'i dam tshig bsgom bya las mi 'da' bas/ de skad ces bka' stsal to/ / dom dang dom 'od dpag med kyi/ dang bya rgod de bzhin bse/ / ru gcig smyug ba men zer glang dang ni stag nyid dang*/ /spre'u dang sna 'thung chu srin na kra yin/ ba lang 'tshe/ / lce spyang*/ rdo rje chos kyi g.yas na'o/ khwa 'ug bya dkar aṃ dzi nā bha ṣ+ṭha mu sa kaṃ chu skyar zer/ seng ge dang*/ /mtshor sa ra sa/ gnas de bzhin ra dang ni/ / lug dang zer/ ri dwags khri snyan sa le/ phag dang yang dag ldan/ /g.yas min par ni rtag tu gnas/ /rma bya rnam par snang mdzad/ ma he chu srin ma ka ra/ dang*/ /nya ro hi ta/ yi rgyal po rus sbal sbrul gyi/ dang*/ /'og gi klu dang ngang pa skya bo/ dang*/ /ri bong phan pa'i g.yas pa na/ /sbal da byid/ pa rta sprul/ thu dz+ye ṣ+ṭhi bo sprin shugs da byid srog chags 'dze ta dang*/ /srog chags ha la ha la dang*/ /an dzi dang ni byi ba dang*| |zer/ kyi/ / ha li'i sbrul de ha la ha la/ mgyogs pa/rtsangs pa/ kha chu mig sman rmigs pa/ mtshungs byi ba/ / gran+dhin

g.yag bud med du'ang byed/ dang dri ldan gla ba zer/ de bzhin bya/ bzhad | | sa ra pa zer/ g.yon pa'i thod pa brgyad na'o/ / rin 'byung gi ka ran ta ki bya/ dang 'khor tsakra bha gha ste ngur pa ser po/ lo ngag /lug rgod/ dang tsa ko ra mtshan mo rgyu ba'i bye'u chung*| dang ni/ /bre khra hor khra 'ol ba dang*/ /ku rar nya khra/ nyi ma'i g.yas pa na'o/ / stod mi thal mo sbyar ba spyi bor sbrul gyi gdengs ka smad sbrul 'khyil ba ljang stobs kyi rgyu dang dung dkar| skyong dang*/ /rigs bkra/ ldan pad+ma sngo skya'o/ / pad bzang sngo skya can/ /'jog dmar| po nor rgyas ser/ mtha' yas ni/ / sngo/ rin chen rgyal po'i g.yon na'o/ / rta mchog gi gza' lhag dkar phur bu ser po/ mjug rings sngo/ dang*/ /sgra gcan sngo nag mig dmar dmar/ pa wa sangs/ / dkar/ spen pa nag khyab 'jug blau/ rta rgyal ni/ / g.yas pa nyid du rab tu grags/ /dbang po dkar/ tshangs pa ser/ de bzhin drag / sngo| 'dod dmar/ lha de bzhin thong ba ljang*/ can/ / khyab 'jug gi bu mo gang ba bzang mo gshol mda' 'dzin/ dkar/ gcer mu stegs/ bu 'i ston pa rgyal ba dam pa/ dang ni thag bzangs lha ma yin/ ris ljang */ /stobs sngau/ ldan lha min dbang po bha li'o// zhes bya g.yon pa na'o/ / mi bskyod pa'i phyag mtshan du bstan de'i dag pa/ g.yas kyi phyag mtshan rnams ni spang bya nad brgyad/ g.yon gyi phyag mtshan rnams ni spong byed gnyen po brgyad/ yang na nad brgyad dang bral ba'i dbang phyug brgyad glo dang dbugs dang de bzhin 'bog khong skems khrag skyug mdze dang rkang shu 'brum bu/ dang*/ /mchin pa khong skran lgang ba'i rang bzhin rnams/ zer/ mcher ba'i rang bzhin yang*/ / nad brgyad po de sems can gyi lus las phyung nas rang gi lus la bsdus pa'i sgo nas sel glang po la sogs rab tu grags ( 1 ) / / nad brgyad dang bral ba ster ba ni g.yon gyi phyag mtshan gyi phan yon lcags 'od dpag med kyi/ rtags

lhog pa/ dang ni gzhang nad dang ni 'bog nad dang zer/ brjed byed dran pa nyams pa/ dang*/ khrag rdo gcin sri/ gcong nad rgyal po dang | | rgyu nad sbos nad bkres nad dang zer gzhang 'brum skran dang bkres nad rlung spu gri/ dang | | mig gsha' ya/ ser dom la 'od dpag med kyi dag pa/ sogs ( 2 ) pa'o/ /rdzi ma mig tshag pa la sogs pa'i nad dang*/ byi mig nad/ dang so nad dang*/ / zer/ 'khris pa khrag dang de bzhin rlung*/ /bad kan 'dzag dang lus gas mtshan bar rdol ba ste phol/ dang*/ / skya rlung*/ rbabs 'bras ni rma bya ( 3 ) sogs/ / rnam par snang mdzad kyi dag pa/ skrangs rkang bam khong sbos chu so na zer/ tshil nad rlig skrangs dang*/ /rgyu dmu chu/ ma 'phel lgang nad dang ni klad gzer dang zer/ dang gsud pa 'grangs nad med/ dang*/ / dug 'brum/ tshad tsha rims| pa 'khru nad tshad nad rkang 'brum rnams/ /zer/ rims dang 'khru nad kyi/ rab gas ni/ / ka chu 'gags sam rkang 'brum/ ran ḍa sogs rab tu rin 'byung gi g.yas/ grags/ / ( 4 ) rlung mkhris de bzhin ma zhu ba/ /sgrib g.yogs rab rib ling tog rab rib za gu can| |zer gcin sri ba/ /gzhogs phyed na dang lkog 'bras dang*/ /rlung rgyas pa'i nad| gza' lhag la don grub kyi/ sogs ( 5 ) pa'o/ / 'gro ba rnams kyi rab mchog ni/ /mi rnams kyi ni 'gro ba ste/ /zer/ mi yi 'gro ba'ang rigs nges pa dang ma nges pa rnams kyis byang chub gsum thob pa'i phyir dam pa ste gzhan skye gnas dang shes rab dman pa'i phyir ro// dam pa ni/ /rab mchog de lta bur 'gro ba/ /thams cad nad kyis brgyad tshan lnga po des/ khyab mthong nas | | sangs rgyas lngar ni cher grags pas/ /bdag nad de rnams/ gi lus la 'am phyag mtshan rnams la/ gzhug par bya/ /sems can rnams la nad kyis/ gdungs ma gyur// nad rnams zhi phyir sangs rgyas ni/ /glang po la sogs nad 'dzin to/ / phan yon de ltar de lta bu'i phyag mtshan bsgom pa'i rigs lnga bsgoms pa ni/

bsgom par gyur pa la/ /nad med thig nag gi nad/ ru tsa nad bu khong nad med zer/ treng drum med/ /'chi ba/ med nges par phol nad med/ / 'chi ba med cing khong khro med/ /zer bde /nad kyi rgyu/ nga rgyal med cing gti mug med/ / rgyu med pas bkres pa med cing skom pa med/ / tshe phyi ma la/ sdug bsngal ngan 'gro de bzhin med/ /lha dang lha min mi rnams sam/ /gang gis kyang ni nad med min/ /nad rnams sus kyang 'chi bar mi 'gyur ro/ /gang du'ang nad du mi 'gyur ro// zer thams cad rab tu zhi ba yis gdul bya rnams/ dbugs dbyung ba las mi phyed pas/

rdo rje zhes bya ba'i le'u ste lnga pa sho lo ka sum cu so drug dang rkang pa gnyis bzhugs so// 'o// // de nas rdo rje 'dzin pa'i rgyal po de nyid/ lus rigs lnga po/ thams cad du bstan/ 'dzin pa po lus la bde ba byin pa'i sgo nas/ mkha' 'gro ma'i tha mal pa'i/ yid 'phrog pas tshig 'di bka' stsal pa/ mi bskyod pa sems kyi rjes dran mi bskyod pa'i dam tshig sems dpa'/ dmigs nas ni/ / rnam snang sangs rgyas phyis de nyid dran pa'i yul du byas la goms par bya/ rjes su dran rnam snang gi dam tshig sems dpa' 'og ma la 'gre/ pa bsgom/ / sems dam tshig sems dpa'/ kyi rin chen rin 'byung*/ bsams nas ni/ /chos dam tshig sems dpa'/ ni rjes 'od dpag med/ su dran pa bsgom/ /las dam tshig sems dpa'/ rjes dran pa'i rnal don grub/ 'byor pas/ /'khor dam tshig lo chen bsdus pa'i dkyil 'khor bsgoms pa'i/ po rab bsgom 'khor gyi lha rdzogs pa bya/ /rnal 'byor bsdus pa'i dkyil 'khor/ 'di ni mchog rab ste/ / sngar rgyud gzhan du ma byung phyis/ 'byung bar mi 'gyur ro/ / mi bskyod pa' ིrdo rje dam tshig gi dkyil 'khor/ sems dpa' dges rdor/ rnam bsgoms nas/ / dam tshig pa bskyed la skye mched dang sku gsung thugs byin gyis brlab/ phyag rgya bzhi yi phyag rgyas gdab | | 1ye shes kyi 'khor lo dgug gzhug bya ba dang dbang bskur rgyas gdab bo/ /2yang na sku byin gyis brlab pa dang*/ gsung byin gyis brlab pa dang*/ thugs byin gyis brlab pa ting nge 'dzin sems dpa' bsgom pa'o/ /yang na 'khor lo bzhis rgyas gdab pa ste bzhi'o// rdo rje rnam snang dam tshig sems dpa'| bsams nas ni/ /phyag rgya bzha ིbsgoms pas phyag rgya bzhi yi/ sa gdab/ /rdo rje phyag rgya bzhi 'i sbyor ba yis/ /rin chen phung po rab la phyag rgyas gdab pa/ bsgom par| bya/ / 'od dpag med la chos kyi phyag rgya rab sbyor bas/

/las bzhis btab la bsgom| kyi rdo rje'i phyag rgya bzhi sa gdab/ / mi bskyod pa'i dam tshig gi 'khor lo/ zhe sdang dag pas| rgyal po rgyal po che/ / zhe sdang gi skyon rnams thams cad zad par mdzad/ / mi bskyod pa'i dam tshig gi 'khor lo sems dpa' sum rtseg tu bskyed pa'i ting nge 'dzin sems dpa' las 'od zer/ spro zhing sbyor bas bsgom par bya/ / yang na ni bskyed pa/ bsdus pa ye shes 'khor lo mdun du/ yang ni yang dag rdzogs pa/ bshad/ /sangs rgyas dag pa'i don 'di rnams la yang 'gre/ mgon po rab bsgoms nas/ /sangs rgyas kyi sprin gyi 'od zer/ sprin gyis kun tu khyab/ / pa'i/ spro dang bsdu ba'i rnal 'byor gyis/ /sangs rgyas byang chub rab bsgom bya/ /sems kyi rin chen rin po ches/ /bdud kyi nga rgyal gyi/ skyon rnams zad par mdzad/ /sems kyi char sprin sbyor ba yis/ /yang ni bsdu ba bstan par bya/ /chos kyi rgyal po 'dod chags su 'ong gti mug che/ /spro dang bsdu ba'i gzugs can te/ /thun tshod bzhir ni byin gyis brlab/ /bsgoms na myur du mchog gi dngos grub/ 'grub par 'gyur/ /sems ni mgyogs 'gro ste rta mchog don yod grub pa/ ltar bsams dam tshig gi 'khor lo/ nas/ / gzhan don gtso bor gyur pa'i/ gzhal du/ med pa'i/ 'bras bu stsol ba po/ /rta mchog gi ting nge 'dzin sems dpa'/ char sprin chen 'od zer spros pa las/ po yis/ /bsdu ba ye shes 'khor lo'am yang na rdzogs pa/ yang ni bsgom par bya/ /bcom ldan 'das kyis 'od/ spro ba dang ye shes/ bsdu ba'i las mi 'da' bas/ dam tshig chen po de skad ces bka' stsal to/ / mi bskyod pa'i dam tshig sems dpa'i snying khar| nyi ma'i dkyil 'khor dbus gnas par/ / dam tshig gi 'khor lo sems dpa' sum rtseg de nyid gsal bar sems kyi rnam pa hūm̐ ste gzung 'dzin gyis stong pa'i yid tsam/ bsgom par bya | | rnyog med

rnam snang gi snying kha na/ dkyil 'khor zla ba'i/ dbus gnas par/ /sku yi oṃ/ yi ge rnam par bsgom/ khrag gi nyi ma'i dkyil 'khor dbus gnas par/ / sems kyi rin chen yi ge traṃ/ dgod/ /chos kyi zla ba'i/ dkyil 'khor dbus gnas par | | gsung gi yi ge a/ rnam par bsgom/ /las kyi nyi ma'i dkyil 'khor dbus gnas par/ /don yod yi ge'i gzugs khaṃ ngam ha/ can te/ /sku gsum mi phyed dam tshig sems dpa' sku'i/ yi ge gsung/ ting nge 'dzin sems dpa' thugs/ bsgoms pa yis/ /ye shes rdo rje ye shes 'khor lo dgug gzhug bya ba/ bsgom par bya/ /rdo yang na 'di rnams lha so so'i spyi bor mtshan zer rje sa bon las phyag mtshan gang dang gang bsgom zhe na/ sems dpa' mi phyed hūm̐ las rdo rje*/ pa/ /chos kyi oṃ las/ 'khor lo rtsibs bcu pa/ rnam snang la/ /rin chen sems kyi traṃ las/ rin po che/ /pad+ma bzang po a las/ pad+ma dmar/ /shes rab ha 'am khaṃ las/ ral gri don yod kyi/ /shes rab rnon po'i rang bzhin gyis/ /rnam rtog ri bo bcad nas ni/ / lha'i sku/ phyag rgya sngags dang phyag rgyas btab pa yin/zer/ chen phyag mtshan de las so so'i yig 'brus mtshan pa las ye shes sems dpa' de'i snying khar ting nge 'dzin sems dpa'/ por ldan par 'gyur/ / gzhal yas khang rgya khyon ji tsam gyi nang du bsgom pa bstan pa dpag tshad bye ba rgyas pa rgya dang tshad ma chad par ni/ /rdo rje'i a las/ dkyil 'khor bsgom par bya/ / de bzhin du/ phan pa'i dkyil 'khor nyid dang yang*/ /rin chen phung po'i 'od chen dang*/ /chos kyi phung po mgon chen dang*/ /de bzhin gshegs pa rdo rje las | | kyi yang tshad 'dra'o//gzhal yas khang*/ sna tshogs 'od zer cher 'bar ba/ / lha'i 'khor lo sangs rgyas sprin gyis rnam par brgyan/ / 'khor gyi lha mos mdun gyi nam mkha'i khams kyi bsrung ba'i 'khor lo'i nang chos 'byung gi dbus gnas sa bon gyi 'od zer gyis/

par//ye shes gzhal yas khang*/ dkyil 'khor spyan drangs te/ bsgom par bya/ / de'i nang du/ 'dod de la/ pa'i yon tan lnga yis gang*/ / sa bon las spros pa'i lha mo/ thams cad du ni sna tshogs gzugs/ /mchod pa kun gyis mchod par bya/ / phyogs mtshams snying kha nas gau rī la sogs pa bton te/ kyi lha mo'i sbyor ba puk+ka sī la sogs pas bskul ba'i/ yis/ /ye shes zhi ba las bzhengs pa/ rgya mtsho rab bsgrub bya/ /dam de nas/ tshig 'khor lor bcug pa yi/ /ye shes dam tshig sems dpa' ye shes kyi ngo bo tha dad med par/ rdo rje chen po 'bar | | sangs rgyas kun dang mnyam pa'i/ rnal 'byor pa/ /skad cig dam tshig sems dpa' la ye shes pa bstim pa'i/ la ni gnyis med dam tshig pa dang ye shes pa dbyer med par/ 'gyur | | ru rak+sha dang ral gri bse ru/ dang*/ /bu yi 'tsho bo dhi tse/ ba pad 'bras dang*// mu tig la sogs byi ru sogs/ /bsam gtan ldan par lha mo'i zhal nas byung zhes sogs| sngags bzlas par/ bya sa pas dgos pa'i 'bras bu/ sangs rgyas byang chub sems dpa' dang*/ /mkha' ye shes kyi dang las kyi sogs/ 'gro ma gau rī/ dang rang btsun mo/ / nai rāt+mā spyan sogs mngon sum du ni bdag la mnyes par/ bya ba'i phyir/ /sngags ni snyan gsan 'bebs par brjod/ /dper na skyes chen la la zhig /skad kyi nga ros bos pa la/ /thos pa tsam gyis 'bod mkhan gyi gam du/ 'ong 'gyur ba/ /de ltar skad cig nyid so so'i sngags kyis bskul ba'i/ sangs rgyas kyang sngags zlos mkhan gyi drung du/ gshegs// gnas gang na bzhugs zhe na 'jig rten khams ni stong phrag gi grangs/ dang*/ / mnyam pa'i/ nam mkha'i khams kyi mkha' grong 'og min/ du/ /phyag rgya chen po'i la/ bde bar/ gnas pas/ kyis/ / grangs mkha' dang mnyam pa'i sangs rgyas bzhugs/ /de rnams sngags rig sku dngos su/ drung mi gshegs/ /rdo rje'i spyan gyis rnam par gzigs | | shing byin gyis rlob/

gang gis sngags kyi bzlas pa'i man ngag gi/ rim thob pa// thugs bskul sgrub pa po la byin gyis brlab pa'i sgo nas/ e ma de yis byang chub thob/ / des na sangs rgyas byang chub sems dpa' yang*/ / rgyu yin pas sngags kyi bzlas pa/ spyod pa dang po sangs rgyas pa'i sngon rol du/ 'dzin/ / man ngag dang ldan pas bzlas pa rdo rje'i sngags ni rab bsgoms pas/ /mtshungs pa med pa'i ye shes thob/ /de ltar shes pa'i ye shes dang 'dra ba'i rnal 'byor/ de/ /sngags kyi spyod pa'i rim pa/ gnas pa/ / 1de/ lan gcig 'bras 3bu sangs rgyas dang mnyam zhes pa de/ nyid dgongs pa min gyi da lta rang du'o// la mi gzigs te/ /de2ni sangs rgyas mnyam par brjod/ /sangs bskyed rim/ rgyas dkyil 'khor 'khor lo'i nga rgyal dmigs nas ni/ / rdzogs pa chos kyi dbyings ni dkyil 'khor 'khor lo de nyid/ 'od gsal ba/ /gang zhig bsgom pa de bas na/ / rim pa gnyis sgom mkhan de sems can de/ sangs rgyas dang mnyam par 'gyur/ / te sku gsum thob/rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas bshad 'jig rten gyi sems/ ji ltar sangs rgyas rang bzhin gyis rtog pa dang bral ba/ de/ / bsam gyis mi khyab pa lhun gyis grub pa'i/ ji ltar chos sku/ ni rtog pa'i/ rnyog pa/ med pa/ / de bzhin du sems can khams kyi sems kyang rang bzhin gyis rnyog pa med pa/ ni de ltar bshad/ /nam mkha' lta bur rang bzhin gyis/ dri ma med/ / 'o na cis ma grol zhe na ngan par brtag pa'i glo bur gyi gzung ba dang 'dzin pa dang bdag la sogs par snang ba'i/ rnam rtog gis/ /rin chen dang 'dra ba'i/ sems ni dri can byas/ / te sgrib shing sbags so|| sems de dri ma las/ dag pas ni dag par sangs rgyas su/ 'gyur/ / de'i dpe ji ltar nam mkha' glo bur gyi khug sna la sogs pa dang bral te rang bzhin gyis/ mi 'jig pa ra brtan pa ltar| nam mkha' de'ang rang bzhin gyis skye 'jig med/ ji bzhin de bzhin sems/

/ de'ang glo bur gyi dri ma dang bral ba'o// sems kyi rin chen dang 'dra ba de/ bskul de bsgoms pa las// sems nyid bsgom pa la/ sa sangs rgyas su 'gyur/ te/ /skye ba 'di/ ra sangs rgyas dam pa nyid/ / 'on te phyi rol gyi ka ba la sogs 'di logs na yod snyam na rin chen sems las phyir gyur pa'i/ /sangs rgyas med cing gang zag gi bdag kyang med/ /rnam par shes pa'i gnas don dam/ / snod la sogs par snang ba phyi rol gyur pa'ang cung zad med | | yid kyis sems kyi rang bzhin rtogs pa las sangs rgyas thams cad nyid/ khams longs spyod dang sprul pa/ gsum dbang phyug chen po ste/ /'jig rten gsum gyi rgyal po bdag po yin pas/ che/ /sems skye med du rtogs pa/ gcig gis ni thob par 'gyur | | gzugs dang sgra dang de bzhin dri/ /ro dang reg bya'i rang bzhin skyes// glo bur du snang ba de yang*/ chos kyi dbyings rang bzhin du/ ni mchog glo bur du snang yang rang bzhin gyis mi snang bas/ tu zhi/ / glo bur du sna tshogs su snang ba 'di ni rin chen mchog tu brjod/ / gzhan yang gzugs dang tshor ba 'du shes dang*/ /'du byed dang ni rnam shes nyid// 'di dag thams cad sems las skyes/ /thub pa lnga po/ 'di ni sems las/ gzhan mi 'gyur/ /yid bzhin nor bu rin po che/ / ltar/ 'dod don 'bras bu rab ster ba | | rgyu'i rgyud sems kyi de nyid rang bzhin dag pa las/ sangs rgyas byang chub 'bras bu ster/ /de nyid phyir na sngags rgyal sangs rgyas/ gyis/ / rang bzhin skye med sems kyi rdo rje bskul ba yis/ / ngag byin rlabs kyis mngon du byas pa zab mo rnam pa rnyed ldan pa'i/ /phyed par dka' ba'i phyag rgya chen po'i/ dngos grub ster/ / sems skye med nyid rdo rje sems dpa'i snying po'i de nyid sna tshogs su/ snang ba'i le'u ste drug sho lo ka so dgu dang rkang pa gnyis bzhugs so// pa'o// //de nas rdo rje can chen po rdo rje can mkha' 'gro ma'i rdo rje gur bskyed

yan chad gsum pa dbang bzhi pa mchod pa/ pa'i rim pa'i/ rnal 'byor gyi ting de mngon du mdzad pa'i/ nge 'dzin la bzhugs te/ mi bskyod pa'i bdag nyid he badz+ra/ kyi rnal 'byor gsungs pa/ ud pa ti kra ma le'u bzhi par yan lag drug tu mi gsal ba de gsal ba'i tshul gyis bshad/ ( ka ) sangs rgyas gnas ni rnam rdzogs dang*/ / ( ga ) rnam pa lnga po bsgom pa yis dang | | kun tu rgyu'i rdo rje 'chang*/ bzang po'i rang bzhin gyi/ dang*/ /rang gi gang 'dod/ lhag pa'i lhar bsgrub dang*/ /dkyil 'khor rnams kyi dgod pa dang*/ / 'khor gyi lha mo dbyung ba dang yab yum 'od du zhu ba dang glus bskul ba dang*/ 'bras bu rdo rje 'chang du gzhengs pa dang*/ sku gsung thugs dang skye mched byin gyis brlab pa ( cha ) 3mchod 2bstod ( tha ) bdun rtsi la sogs pa sa rang byin rlabs phra mo'i rnal 'byor bsdu/ rim pas gzhal yas khang bskyed pa la sogs pa/ rjes su bsgom par bya//rnal 'byor bskyed pa yis/ yan lag drug tu 'dod//oṃ sarba ta thā ga tā a bhi ṣe ( ca ) ka ta badz+ra swa bhā ba āt+ma ko3 haṃ/ bcom ldan 'das de bzhin gshegs pa mi bskyod pas de skad ces bka' ba stsa la to/ /oṃ sarba ta thā ga tā a mṛ ( tha ) ta swā da ( na ) badz+ra swa bhā ba āt+ma ko3 haṃ/ bcom ldan 'das de bzhin gshegs pa rdo rje tshe dpag tu med pas de skad ces bka' bstsal to/ /oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta stu ( ta ) ti badz+ra swa bhā ba āt+ma ko3 haṃ/ bcom ldan 'das de bzhin gshegs pa rin chen tog gis de skad ces bka' bstsal to/ / oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta pū tsa badz+ra swa bhā ba at+ma ko3 haṃ/ bcom ldan 'das de bzhin gshegs pa rta mchog gis de skad ces bka' bstsal to/ /oṃ sarba ta thā ga tā a nu rā ga ṇa badz+ra swa bhā ba āt+ma ko3 haṃ/ /bcom ldan 'das de bzhin gshegs pa rdo rje sems dpa' zer/ nyi mas de skad ces bka' bstsal to/ /rnam ( kha ) 'byung ba rim rtseg gi dkyil 'khor gyi steng du bruṃ las 'khor lo bruṃ gyis mtshan pa las rnam snang spros bsdus te sems can gyi don byas tshur bsdus nas/

par rgyal po chen po dang 'dra ba ste rnam snang rang la bya ba'am yang na de'i phyag mtshan la yang bya ste gang yin yang de'i sa bon las/ snang mdzad rgyal po che/ / na pos ngo bo gzhal yas khang*/ spro ba dang ni bsdu ba'i lus/ / las gzhal yas khang*/ chos kyi dbyings rnam snang ngam gzhal yas khang de'i rgyu ci las bskyed pa/ kyi yi ges las dngos po thams cad skye bas bruṃ las gzhal yas khang*/ bskyed/ /des ni sangs rgyas rnam snang gi ngo bo/ gnas dgod par| bya/ /oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta ni la pho brang*/ ya badz+ra swa bhā ba āt+ma ko3 haṃ/ rnam

gzhal yas khang bskyed pa de rnam snang gi ngo bo las mi phyed pas rdo rje/ par snang mdzad rdo rje zhes bya ba'i ting nge 'dzin to// //nam gong gi gzhal yas khang bskyed pa de gsal bar bstan/ mkha'i khams kyi dbus gnas bsrung ba'i 'khor lo'i nang du chos 'byung bsgoms nas/ par/ /'byung bzhi'i nang du byang sems kyi 'byung ba bzhi la sbyar/ bdag nyid dkyil 'khor nyid/ /de yi steng du sangs rgyas bruṃ las rnam snang gsungs te 'khor lo rang ngo*// bsam/ / de las 'od spros bsdus/ nas gzhal zhu ba las 'od kyi dkyil 'khor bsgrub par yang res gsung*/ yas gnas dgod bya/ /rdo rje lta bur mi res mi bskyod pa chos kyi dbyings kyi ngo bo yin te rtog pas mi phyed pas/ phyed rnam pa yab yum zhal sbyor/ phyir/ /des ni mi bskyod pa yab yum/ bsgom par bya/ /ma yum chos kyi dbyings kyi bdag nyid/ skyes rjes su dran pa las/ /rnam par snang mdzad yab yum/ phan pa nyid/ /rin chen rnams kyi mchog yab yum/ gi mchog /'di ni rin chen sems su bshad/ /rdo rje chos ni rgyal po che/ /'dod chags mtshan rnam par dag pa'i/ nyid 'dzin pa las/ /rdo rje sems dpa' gnas 'dug pa'i/ /sems ni 'od dpag med kyis bsdus pa'i dkyil 'khor gyi dbang du byas na dbus kyi lte ba na 'dug pas/ 'dod chags zhes byar bshad/ /gang phyir 'bras bu dang*/ bral ba/ min sgrub pa'i 'bras bu ster ba/ ltar/ / de phyir don yod rab mtshon par bya ba'i ye shes de tshig gis dngos su mtshon pa yin/ tu grags// rig ma rig pa zlog par byed pa/ ma mdzes pa rdo rje zhes bya ba'i ting nge 'dzin to// //bum pa'i dbang ni le'u bzhi par bum dbang tsam gsungs kyang dbang bzhi ka ma gsungs pas de kha bskang gi tshul du bstan gsung*/ dang po ste//gnyis pa las ni gsang ba'i dbang*// gsum pa shes rab ye shes te/ / shes rab ye shes kyi dus su myong ba'i ngo bo/

ji ltar bzhi pa| lus ni de bzhin du ston/ gshegs/ / mdor rgyas dkyil bum dbang*/ 'khor dam rdul mtshon/ pa bris nas ni/ /dam yab yum snyoms par zhugs pa las mi 'da' bas/ tshig sems kyi/ khu ba'i cho cho ga ji bzhin sbyin par byas zer/ rgya dpe la snang*/ ga yis/ / brten pa sregs pa hoṃ phyung la snyoms par 'jug pa las byung ba'i byang sems de bza' gsung*/ dang bde ba'i/ bsam gtan bskyed byas nas/ / nang gi sbyin sreg byas nas ni zer/ bum dbang de tshe dbugs dbyung gi dbang*/ sbyin par bya/ /mkha' bum pa'i/ 'gro rigs/ lnga dang ldan pa dang*/ / dam bdud rtsi lnga/ tshig lnga yis bkang ba dang*/ /mkha' spyan la sogs pa/ 'gro ma yi tshogs ldan bum pa thogs/ pas/ /slob ma de bzhin gshegs pa zhu ba/ rdo rje can dbang bskur | | rdo rje 'i dbang*/ sa bon khu ba/ rab sbyor ba las byung*/ bas/ /rang gi lhag pa'i lhar bla mas he ru kar/ sbyar nas/ /slob ma bum dbang thob pas lus kyi dri ma dag pas na/ rtag par nges bsams te/ /rgyun byang sems lce la 'jog pa/ gyi rigs kyi ming gis ā li kā li gang la bab pa las ming 'dogs pa ni/ /slob ma rdo rje can dbang bskur/ / rgya dpe la 'di mi snang rang gi lha'i rnal 'byor gyi bye brag gis spyan dang bdag mo shes rab ye shes kyi rten/ sgrol ma dang*/ / gos dkar mo la sogs par bskyed pa/ bdag gzugs kyis/ /rdo rje btsun mo dang*/ rab sbyor 'du shes gsum dang ldan pas/ bas/ /rdo rje bzhi pa gsum pa'i ye shes mngon du byed par bla med bshad par bya/ /bla bzhi pa/ na gsum pa'i nyams su myong ba'i mtshan nyid/ med pa'i de nyid 'di/ /gnyis gzung 'dzin/ su med cing brjod bya/ yi ge med | | chos kyi dbyings ni 'od gsal ba rtogs par/ byed/ / der bde ba mi rtog pa'i ngo bor myong bas/ bde ba bzang po'i ro myong gis/ /sgrib dbang bskur bas rtog pa dag pas/

pa med pa'i rdo rje zhes bya ba'i ting nge 'dzin to// // gsang ba'i dbang gi dam tshig gha dang ha zhes dang po gha bi ba glang*/ dang po hasti glang*/ bya ba dang | | dang po na shwa yod pa shwa na ste khyi/ mthar yang shwa ldan pa'i ( a shwa ste rta ) / /rab tu gsal ba mi'i/ dam pa nyid/ /dngos bsten pa'i dgos pa/ grub thams cad rab ster ba | | cho bdud rtsi byin gyis brlabs pa'i/ gas rdo rje bdud rtsi ra brlabs la myang*/ /'di dag zos pa tsam gyis ni/ /sangs rgyas kun dang*/ mnyam pa'i/ rnal 'byor pa/ /rdo rje sems dpa'/ dang ni mnyam par 'gyur/ /nad rnams thams cad rab tu zhi/ /de ni gzi brjid lus chen po/ /'jig rten kun gyi yid 'phrog pa/ /phas kyi rgol ba kun las rgyal/ /'jig rten kun gyi bdag pos 'khor los sgyur bas kyang bstod/ brgyan | | lha rnams kyi ni 'dren pas rjed/ /mkha' sha lnga rgyal ba lngar mos pa'am byin gyis brlabs nas zos pas/ 'gro lnga yi bdag nyid 'gyur/ /chos ye shes lnga'i bdag nyid bdud rtsi lnga byin gyis brlabs nas/ kyi zas ni za ba po/ /dam tshig bsten pa las mi 'da' bas| chen po'i bsam gtan zos pa zhes bya ba'i ting nge 'dzin to/ / dri chu mi bza' ba'i dam tshig lnga bstan nas bdud rtsi bza' ba bstan/ bskyod bsten pa'i rnal 'byor pa/ / nad rnams thams cad rnam par spangs/ / dri chen rtag pas lus mdangs dang ldan pa/ chu shel chen por ldan/ /rdo rje rak+tas/ nyi mas rgas pa med/ / ( rdo rje chos ni bsten pa yis/ /bud med kun la longs spyod do/ / zhes sde spar du 'dug kyang dpyad/ ) don yod rgyal po chen po ni/ /rdo rje srog tshe ring*/gi yan lag 'byung*/ /don sha dri chen lus mdangs dang ldan pa/ rak+tas/sde spar du 'dug kyang dpyad zhes tshe ring*/chen/shachen/ kun sgrub cing dpal dang ldan/ /des ni rnal 'byor par pas bsten/ ni brjod/ /mi bskyod btung ba'i sbyor ba las/

/stong phrag lngar ni 'tsho bar 'gyur/ /phan dri chen/ pa yis ni khri ru brjod/ /rdo rje nyi ma rak+ta/ rdo rje'i 'bum/ /tshe dpag khu ba/ med kyis dpag med dang | | bdun rgyal/ gyis nam sha chen/ mkha' ji srid gnas kyi bar du mi 'chi bar/ bshad// rdo rje rak+ta nyi ma dang*/ dpag khu ba/ med dang*/ /'khor ba'i sgrub thabs rtsa ba shu tra/ sih+la| gnyis/ /'di dag brten pas rnal 'byor pa/ /kun tu bzang po dang*/ 'dra bar 'gyur/ / bud med de brdar btags pa' ི shes ji ltar 'gyur na/ rab pha rol phyin ye sih+la ste ye shes kyi rten yin pas/ shes/ /'di ni bu tsha la sogs/ rdo rje nyi mar brjod/ /chos rnams thams cad kyi ni thabs/ /de bzhin gshegs pa tshe dpag med/ /sangs rgyas rdo rje can nyid kyi/ /thabs shu kra/ dang shes rab zhon sih+la/ pa dag / bsten pa/ khams 'dod khams rang la gsum du bzhag gsum dag ni thams cad du/ / 'dod khams kyi sa dang sa 'og bar snang la/ khrag dang khu bas khyab pa'i lus/ /rigs kyi dbang phyug ka k+ko la la brten nas dngos grub thob pa/ gis 'di gsungs/ /sen mo ba spu 'i dwangs ma/ de bzhin khams/ khu ba la ni rnam 'od dpag med/ par gzigs/ /pags dang khrag la rin chen 'byung ldan/ gzi brjid che/ tshil dang rkang la rdo rje 'dzin/ / mi bskyod pa/de thams cad bsdus pa/ mgon po rnam snang mdzad/ /rtsa dang sha la bdun rgyal po/ / khams kyi dwangs ma 'di rnams lnga ni sangs rgyas lngar/ /rdo rje mkha' 'gros rnam par bshad/ / rnal 'byor pa rang gi sa yi khams ni rnam dag pa/ / sa ni/ spyan ni 'khor rnam snang gi lo mdzes pa nyid/ /rdo rje btsun mo mā ma kī chu/ dwang ba ste/ / pad gar mkhan gyi btsun mo/ ma'i bu mo tsha ba me gos dkar mo/ nyid/ /sgrol ma rlung ni rnam dag pa/ /rdo rje btsun mo bzhi rnams ni/ /rdo rje 'byung ba bzhi dag pa/ mkha' 'gro zhes bya ba'i/ /gur gyis de rnams bka' stsal to/ /sngags

kyi lha bai ro tsa na la sogs pa thams cad rnam par dag pa bdud rtsi lnga 'i che ba/ mchog tu rgyal ba lnga'i ngo bo yin pas| 'byung ba bdud rtsi lnga rgyal ba lnga dang mi phyed pas/ rdo rje zhes bya ba'i ting nge 'dzin te/ le'u bdun sho lo ka so bdun dang rkang pa gsum bzhugs so// pa'o// // 1sbyang gzhi nyon mongs pa rnams 2le'u bzhi pa dang bdun par mngon rtogs bstan/ lnga pa dang drug par bsdus pa'i dkyil 'khor gyi mtshan nyid bstan pa las rgyu las 'bras bu rdo rje 'chang gzhengs pa'i glu gsungs pa kha bskang ngo*/ khyod ni zhe bstan pa'i sgo nas gdul bya/ sdang dag pa/ rdo rje yongs sems can mgon skyabs byed/ skyong ba/ / zhu ba la mtshams kyi lha mos bskul ba ste bsdus pa'i dkyil 'khor zhu ba'i thig le lnga ka la bskul/gnyis pa nyon mongs pa dang ye shes thugs sku gsung thugs las/ dag ye shes lnga las/ chos kyi dbyings ni shin tu rnam par/ dag pas/ / he ru ka lha yi gsum pa rnams kyis zung 'jug tu bsgrub pa lus ni yang dag brgyan bzhi pa tshad med kyi ngo bo/ mdzad mi bskyod pa la bsdus pa'i dbang du byas pa'o// pa/ /puk+ka sī rigs gzhan dbus su gyur nas yang de'i mtshams mas skul ba'o// ni bdag la myur du skyobs/ gzigs/ /rnam bskyab lugs ji ltar bskyabs na/ par 'khor ba dang ngan song las/ 'dren pa 'jig rtain don lnga pa dgos pa/ gyi phyir | | thig le stong pa nyid spangs drug pa rnams kyi zung 'jug tu bsgrubs zhes ngo bo/ skye ba bzhes gzugs sku/ par mdzod/ khyod bstan pa'i sgo nas gdul bya/ ni gti mug can/ rdo rje yongs skyong ba/ / sku gsung thugs las sku yi dag pa chos kyi gzugs mtshan dang dpe byad kyis brgyan pa/ brnyan me long lta bu/ gyis/ /lha bcom ldan 'das/ yi lus ni yang dag brgyan mdzad pa/ /mgon po ri khrod ma ni bdag la myur du gzigs/ /rnam par 'dren pa 'jig rten sman slad du/

/ bskyab lugs stong pa nyid spangs skye ba bzhes par mdzod | khyod ni 'dod chags rdo rje rang bstan pa/ yongs skyong ba/ / sku gsung thugs gsung dag legs par ye shes lnga las so sor rtog pa yis/ /lha yi lus ni yang dag brgyan mdzad pa/ /gtum par ldan pa bdag la myur du gzigs/ / rnam par 'dren pa 'jig rten sman slad du/ /stong pa bskyab lugs/ nyid spangs skye ba bzhes par mdzod/ / rin chen 'byung ldan dang don yod grub pa gnyis ka bsdus pa/ khyod ni sangs rgyas thams cad kyi rang bzhin/ yongs skyong ba/ / sems can gyi gzugs kun bya ba| nan tan ye shes/ thams cad bsnyon bu/ mnyam pa/ nyid kyis/ / ye shes// lha yi lus ni yang dag brgyan mdzad pa/ /ḍom bi bdag la mgon po myur du gzigs// rnam par 'dren pa 'jig rten sman slad du/ /stong pa nyid spangs skye ba bzhes par mdzod | | thams rigs lnga/ cad zhu ba las 'bras bu rdo rje 'dzin par/ gzhengs par mdzad pa rdo rje zhes bya ba'i ting nge 'dzin to// //'khor rig pas/ lo can rnams thams cad kyis/ / glus bskul ba/ 'dir ni gzhengs par/ bskyed par 'bras bu rdo rje 'dzin par/ 'gyur ba ni/ /ye shes rdo rje sgrub pa nyams su len pa'i rnal 'byor/ can gyis bya/ /dkyil 'khor bdag pos de skad gsungs | | oṃ las dpral bar mkha' spyod ma bskyed/ oṃ sarba ta 'bras bu rdo rje 'chang gzhengs pa la sku gsung thugs byin gyis brlab pa bstan/ thā ga ta khe tsa bzhi pa dang drug par gsungs pa'i don 'dis gsal ba bstan/ ri mkha' spyod/ badz+ra swa rang bzhin/ bhā ba āt+ma yin/ ko3 haṃ/ oṃ sarba a las mgrin pa sa spyod/ ta thā ga ta sa spyod bhū mi/ tsa rī badz+ra swa bhā ba āt+ma ko3 haṃ/ hūm̐ las snying khar rkang 'og na gnas pa oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta pā tā lā wa si rkang 'og na gnas pa/ nī badz+ra swa bhā ba āt+ma ko3 haṃ/ sku gsung thugs kyi chos rnams kyi/ /byin

dpral ba lkog ma snying khar| brlabs gnas su rtag par sku gsung thugs/ ni/ /ye shes rdo rje sgrub pa pos/ can gyis bya/ /'di ni byang chub rim thob par byed pa'i/ bstan pa'o/ /bcom ldan 'das sku dang gsung dang thugs kyi bdag pos de skad ces bka' stsal to// phyag sku gsung thugs byin gyis brlabs pa'i dgos pa bstan rgya chen po rab sbyor bas/ / skur bskyed pa ste mkha' spyod sku lha'i skur bskyed pa/ yi rkang 'og na gnas pa/ rin chen sbyang tha mal gyi rtog pa/ bar bya/ / so so'i skur bskyed/ bsam rdzogs rim gyi mi rtog pa bsgom pa/ gtan rdo rje bsams nas ni/ sems kyi rin po/ chen dang 'dra ba/ rab sa 'og na gnas pa/ sgrub byed// tsita badz+rar/ rdo rje ngag gi bzlas pa'i khyad par gyis/ / lha mo'i zhal nas zhes sogs/ ngag gi sa spyod/ rdo rje dri ma tha mal pa'i/ med/ /gti skye mched byin gyis brlab pa'i dgos pa bstan/ mug rdo rje rab sbyor bas/ /mig gi rnam par shes pa'i tha mal rtog pa sbyang*/ /zhe rna ba/ sdang rdo rje'i bsam pa yi/ /sgra yi sgo rna ba/ yi bsam pa'o/ /sna ni ser sna rdo rje yis | | sbyang*/ ro drug la longs spyod pa'i lce/ 'dod chags rdo rje yis/ / sbyang*/ lus ni phrag dog rdo rje yis/ /yid la kun tu bzang po yis/ /de kun tu bzang po/ nyid mkha' 'gro bdag med ma/ / lha drug po 'di rnams kyis ni thams cad tha mal pa'i lus ngag yid gsum dbang po drug tu zhen pa/ sbyang*/ /gal te 'gal ba don dam pa la sbyang bya sbyong byed| yod pa ma yin pas sbyang bya sbyong byed med do zhe na/ yang*/ /de tshe kun rdzob/ rgyal ba'i dngos pos tha mal pa'i mig la sogs pa/ sbyang ba yod/ /kun rdzob bden pa sbyang ba tha dad du yod pas/ yang dag gnas nas ni/ /'khor dkyil 'khor gyi/ lo'i gzugs kyis chos tsam rnam par tha mal pa'i rtog pa sbyong bas lha'i 'khor lo/

bsgom/ /chos nyid/ kyi don dam par rgyu las/ dngos po ma byung spyad pa las/ /gang zag dang chos kyi bdag thams cad rnam spangs 'jig rten pa/ /'jig rten 'gro ba tha mal pas sbyong ngo zhe na/ bsam par lha'am rang bzhin med par/ mi nus te/ /chos kun rdzob tu/ nyid kyi rim pa nyid kyi/ tshul gyis tha mal pa| thams cad lha mo'am rang bzhin med par/ rnam par dag / tha mal pa la yang kha mig la sogs pa yod la lha la yang yod pas rtog pa spang du mi btub bo zhe na/ sgrib pa sbyong thabs bstan pa/ tshig pa rnams kyi mes/ gdung dang dug khyab 'gro drug pa'i/ /lus kyi sman ni gnas/ gzhan pa'i dug nyid de/ /ji ltar chu ni rna bar zhugs pa la/ /yang ni chu ni thabs su 'gyur ba nyid/ /ji ltar rlung gis dkrugs pa'i sems rnams kyi/ /de bzhin mkhas pas mon sran gre'u

'i bza' ba/ sbyin/ /'dod tha mal pa'i/ chags kyis kyang rmongs pa yi/ /skye chags pa rang bzhin gyis de kho nar ma rtogs pa'i/ bo la 'dod chags thabs khyad par can gyis zin pa'i/ me yis gdung*/ /'dod rgyu/ chags kyis bskyed 'jig rten pa/ /'dod tha mal pa'i/ chags smad pas zad par 'gyur/ / smad pa'i lugs ji ltar zhe na/ 'dod yang na 'dod chags de kho nar rtogs pas/ chags 'du shes gsum dang ldan pas bsten pa/ rdo rjer yongs shes pas/ /yid 'dod chags can gyi/ ni ngo bo/ rdo rje sems dpar 'gyur/ /'dod chags kyi rang bzhin mi rtogs pas/ zhags pas 'ching ba yis | | 'jig rten chags pas khyab ste 'ching*/ par brjod/ /'dod chags kyi rang bzhin de kho na/ bral ba'i mngon byang chub/ / bsten pa lam du byed pa/ 'dod chags mthar phyin rnams mi tha mal pa'i/ 'dod/ /de bas rdo rje sgrol ma yi/ /bsgrub lha bsgom pa dang bzlas pa/ thabs sbyin sreg dang 'brel ba'i/ las kyi tshogs bcu bzhi bstan/ ni/ / cho gas 'dod don thams cad ni/ /bsgrub pa yang dag rab bshad bya/ /de la sgrub thabs las bzlas pa/ 'di rnams ni sngags kyi rkang pa rnams yin te/ oṃ na mo phyag 'tshal 'phags pa spyan ras gzigs dbang phyug / ār+yā ba lo ki te shwa rā ya/ bo dhi byang chub sems dpa'/ satwa ya/ mahā satwa ya/ sems dpa' chen po/ mahā kā ru ṇi kā ya/ snying rje chen po can| tad+ya 'di lta ste/ thā/ oṃ sgrol ma tā re myur du sgrol ma tut+tā re tu ngan 'gro las/ re sarba thams cad rab tu/ gdug pa duṣ+tan+ma ma kri te bdag la gdug pa/ dzaṃ bha ya/ rmugs/ stam+bha ya/ gnon| mo rmongs/ hā ya/ bhan+dha chings/ ya/ hūm̐ hūm̐ hūm̐/ phaṭa phaṭa phaṭa/ sarba thams cad/ stam+bha rengs/ ni tā ra ya kye sgrol ma zhes bod pa/ swāhā/ ma mo'i dkyil 'khor dbus gnas par/ /lha mo sgrol ma bsgom par bya/ /phyag brgyad zhal ni bzhi pa dang*/ / se mo do/ rgyan la sogs pa/ rnams kun gyis rnam par brgyan/

/gser gyi kha dog 'dra bar snying khar zla ba la taṃ bsams la taṃ gyi 'od kyis dkyil 'khor gyi 'khor lo spyan drangs la mchod pa dang bdun rnam dag dang stong par bsgom pa yang bsrung ba'i 'khor lo dang*/ chos kyi 'byung gnas gzhal yas khang bskyed pa yang kha bskang*/ der byang chub pa'am zla ba la rdo rje la sogs pa'i rim pa las bskyed pa/ bsgom/ / las rgyas ba'i dbang du byas bas gsung*/ gzhon nu ma yi mtshan nyid chags pa/ 'bar/ /rdo spyi bor rin 'byung*/ rje nyi ma'i dbang bskur ba'i gnas/ skyes pa'i/ / sangs phyogs bzhir/ rgyas bzhi yi dbu rgyan can/ /lang tsho la ni bab pa'i bcu drug lus | | g.yo rlung gis bskyod tsa na/ ba gser gyi rna cha g.yo ba/ ma/ /sna tshogs pad+ma'i gdan la bzhugs/ /'od zer dmar pos rnam par brgyan/ /rdo rje zhags pa zer te min/ de bzhin du/ /g.yas pas mda' ni 'gengs pa'o/ /rdo rje lcags kyu ut+pal rin po che/ gzhu/ /sdigs mdzub g.yon na 'dzin/ pas 'dzin pa mo/ /rdo rje skyil krung sbyor ba yis/ /gnas gsum po ni bsgrub sa 'og sa bla sa steng*/ par bya/ / dbang du bya ba la sogs pa'i ched du/ shar du me tog sgrol ma ste/ kha dog dkar zhing yid 'ong ma/ /yi ge oṃ las skyes pa mo/ /me tog phreng bas lag pa brgyan/ /phyag gnyis zhal ni gcig pa nyid/ /rgyan rnams kun gyis rnam par brgyan/ /g.yas su lhor/ bdug spos sgrol ma ste/ /mdog nag tā las/ mdzes pa'i gzugs can ma | | spos dang dung gis lag pa yal gas zer/ brel/ /rgyan rnams kun gyis rnam par brgyan/ /nub tu re las/ mar me sgrol ma ste/ /mar me sdong pos lag pa khyab// mdog ser rnam par rgyan chen mo/ /g.yo ba gser gyi rna cha ma/ /byang du dri yi tuṃ las/ sgrol ma ste/ /dri yi dung gis lag pa khyab/ khrag gi mdog ltar lha mo ni// dkyil 'khor snying por nang gi 'phar ma'i phyogs bzhir/ bsgom par bya/

/lcags phyi'i 'phar ma'i sgor tā yis lcags kyu sgrol ma/ re yis zhags pa sgrol ma/ tu yis lcags sgrog sgrol ma/ re yis 'bebs pa'i sgrol ma bskyed/ go rim dkar mo dang ser mo/ dmar mo ljang khu'o// kyu la sogs rab dbye bas/ /der ni sgo yi srung ma bsam/ /steng du hā las/ gtsug tor rnam par| rgyal ba'i sgrol ma/ ma/ / ser mo 'khor lo thogs pa/ 'og tu swā las/ gnod mdzes ma sgrol ma/ rab ( 2 ) bsgom/ / kha dog sngon mo phyag na klu'i zhags pa thogs pa/ ( 1 ) 'khor lo phyag mtshan| klu ( 3 ) zhags bsams nas ni/ /spro de nas ye shes pa 'khor lo dgug gzhug bya bstod pa dang bdud rtsi myang ba'i bar du bya/ zhing sngags ni bzlas par bya/ /oṃ tā re tut+tā re snying kha'i tāṃ la bcu yis bskor/ tu re swāhā/ yi ge bcu yis lha mo bcu/ /pha rol tu/ phyin pa/ bcu 'i ngo bo/ la gnas ma/ /'bras bu sgrol ma/ thams cad rab grub 'jig rten pa'i las rgyas pa/ phyir/ /rab tu 'bad pas bsgom par bya/ /sngags 'di mchog sangs rgyas pa ster ba la/ dang phul du phyin/ /sangs rgyas kun gyis phyag mdzad pa/ / bklags pas grub phyed drag po ste/ /rdo rje gur gyis bshad pa'o/ /sngags 'dis gos kyi thu bar la zla ba'i steng du tāṃ gi 'od kyis stag la sogs pa thams cad bkug ste thu bar 'thums tsam na dbugs phyir mi btang*/ bdun mngon par bsngags pa bya ste/ mdud pa bcings nas nags tshal du 'gro na yang sus kyang mi khyer te/ stag dang chom rkun dang*/ chu srin sna 'thung dang*/ seng ge dang*/ sbrul dang*/ mche glang po che/ ba can dang*/ ma he dang dom dred/ dang*/ smyug glang ba men/ la sogs pa/ tā re'i/ ming dran pa tsam gyis sems/ nyams shing yib bo/ ( 1 ) /sngags 'dis ut+pal sen rtsis zla gam gyi thab khung bri 'i sbyin sreg ji srid du lan brgya rtsa brgyad bzlas pa/ ji tsam par bskur bar bya ste/ oṃ tā re tut+tā re tu re a mu kaṃ me wa sha

che ge mo bdag gi dbang du gyur cig m+mān ya swāhā/ ( 2 ) yang na sngags de nyid yi ge bcu pa la zer/ kyis khwa'i sgro bya rog gi dang rus/ la lan sum cu rtsa gnyis yongs su bzlas te/ dgra'i khyim gyi ya them gyi steng du/ sbas na nyi ma bdun gyis skrod par byed do/ / de'i sngags ni/ oṃ tā re tut+tā re tu re tsa la bskyod pa/ pra tsa la rab tu bskyod pa/ shī myur bar/ gha ga mi 'gro ba ni de lha sbyin| wa rat+ta u tsa skrod/ ta ya hūm̐ phaṭa ( 3 ) de nas gzhan yang dbang du bya ba la/ sbyor bar 'gyur ba/ oṃ tā gzhon nu che ge mo zhes bya ba bdag la lugs bzhin du ster bar gyur cig re tut+tā re tu re a mu che ge mo/ kā bhi dha rna ba ma phug pa/ na ku ma rī ma gzhon nus bskal ba/ h+ya murbā ster ba/ he na ta s+ya lugs bzhin/ bi tā pra ta ya stsol bar gyur cig ts+tsha tu me bdag la/ swāhā | spra tshil ske tshe'i sa bon/ dang shing*/ gtum pa'i sa bon dang*// 'bras bu/ myos byed po so 'cha'/ dang*/ a sho ka'i lo ma dang*/ me tog de'i/ bsreg blugs bya zhing*/ mar dang sbrang rtsi bu ram du bcas pa stong phrag lnga'i sbyin sreg ni bu mo dbang du bya ba/ 'i dngos grub la rab tu bsngags te nyi ma bdun gyis de'i tshe rnal 'byor pas rang 'dod pa'i bu mo 'thob bo/ ( 4 ) /de nas gzhan yang rab dgug pa'i las/ du sbyor bar 'gyur ba/ oṃ tā re tut+tā re tu re a che ge mo/ mu kā bhi dha rna ba ma phug pa/ nāṃ swa s+tha nā rang gi gnas nas bdag gi drung du khug cig ta a kar+ṣa ya ma man+ta ke dzaḥsngags 'dis bha rgya shug dha ra'i tsher ma stong grangs/ phrag lnga rang bzlas te/ byung gi me tog dang*/ bsreg blugs bya bar brjod pa 'di byas pas/ skyes rgyal po'i/ pa skyong ba rnams kyi bu mo yang 'gug par byed do/ ( 5 ) /de nas gzhan yang rab tu sbyor bar 'gyur ba/ zla mtshan 'dzag pa'i ras la bcom ldan 'das ma phyag gnyis ma zhal gcig ma/

lag pa lcags kyu dang ut+pal dang*/ zhags par bcas bsnams pa zer/ pa rnam par bris te/ de'i rab gnas byas la/ mdun du mchod pa me tog mdzes pa bzang po la sogs pas mchod par bya ste zer/ byas na/ me tog 'di rnams bzang zhing legs zhes bya ba la sogs pas mchod nas/ phyi nas sgom pa dang ldan par sngags bzlas par bya'o/ /oṃ tā re tut+tā re a mu che ge mo/ kā ma ma i bdag 'tshal ba rmi lam du gsungs shing*| bis taṃ swap+na ka tha ya hūm̐ phaṭa/ stong phrag lnga bzlas pa/ sa 'ong bar 'gyu ro/ / zhags gang 'gugs par bya rgyu dang*/ pas mgrin par bcings te/ lcags snying kha nas/ kyus drangs nas bsgrub bya rkang pa'i 'og tu bsams te khol mo'i tshul gyis 'ongs pa de dang*/ bza' longs spyad/ bar bya'o/ ( 6 ) /de nas gzhan yang khros pa zhi ba'i/ sbyor bar 'gyur ba/ sgrol ma'i gzugs bdun mngon par bsngags par bya ste/ bdag gi mig gnyis lag pa rdo rje khu tshur bcangs nas mthe bong rim pas phye ste srin lag gnyis la yang bsngags te mig la srin lag gis byug mig sman gyis bsngags pa'i srin lag la rang*/ bsku bar bya zhing*/ rgyal po'i rigs kyi drung du 'jug par bya'o/ /de nas khros pa'am dbang du bya rgyu'i/ rgyal po de/ slob ma dang 'dra bar gus par byed cing 'gal bar mi byed pa dang*/ bka' drin stsol cing snyan par brjod par byed pa dang*/ bran du yang dag par 'gro zhing khros pa yang dbang du 'gyur ba ste/ 'di ni mngon sum du mthong ba ngo mtshar dang bcas pa'o/ ( 7 ) /de nas gzhan yang khu ba 'dzag pa dang chags pa skye/ sbyor bar 'gyur ba sgrol ma'i gzungs lan brgya rtsa brgyad bzlas te | kha gnyis pa'i so sbrul/ dug kham phor so btang bar bsreg thal bar byas nas/ ba kha dog dmar po'i mar dang*/ gong gi dug de nang du gtums la/ ar+k+ka'i shing bal las sdong bu rab tu sbar la/ mig de'i dud pa kham phor las/ sman bsdu bar bya'o/

/mig sman de rdo rje nyi rang byung ma dang*/ rdo rje chos byang sems/ dag dang mnyes pa la/ rta mchog gis bdug sha chen dud pas/ par bya'o/ /thal ba dang lhan gcig mig bsku bar bya ste/ rdo rje mig gis gang bltas pa de/ gal te pad+ma gar gyi dbang phyug mi 'bab na/ de'i byang sems mi skye zhing chags pa mi skye na/ tshe bdag sgrol ma ma lags te/ bdag gis sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das rnams bkrongs pa lags so/ ( 8 ) /de nas gzhan yang rab tu dbang*/ sbyor bar 'gyur ba/ byis pa so med pa'i lce blangs la lkog ma nas drangs ba la lce rtsa nas dbyung*/ la/ sgrol ma'i gzungs bdun mngon par bsngags par byas nas/ bung ba'i rgyal bh+ra ma ra dza bya ba shing gi ming yin shing mngar yin zer| po'i rtsa ba dang*/ ba glang gi gi wang rna spabs 'dra ba/ lhan cig tu byas pas gsum po bsres pa/ dpral gang dbang du bya rgyu la/ bar thig le yongs su bzung ste/ gang bltas pa de dbang du byed do/ ( 9 ) /de nas gzhan yang rab tu sbyor bar 'gyur ba/ lto rang gi ba'i srin bu la gzungs bdun du mngon par bsngags par byas te/ rdo rje dri chu/ chos byang sems/ dang lhan cig so rtsi byas la go la dang ldan par byas nas/ byin te/ 'byor pa mchog so rtsi/ zos pa na mi spong 'byor bdag pa dang*/ gzhan skyes pa/ du mi dga' ba dang*/ gzhan du mi 'gro ba dang*/ rang gi bdag po khyo/ yang spong ngo*/ / 10de nas gzhan yang sbyor bar 'gyur ba/ mar khu mi'i zhun/ chen pos nye bdag gi lus| bar byugs la/ sgrol ma'i gzungs bzlas la de dang*/ bsgom par bya'o/ / bzlas pa'i mthar 'bras/ sā lu btags pas 'da' gu'i dri ma la khur ba byas la des rang gi lus la dril/ te gang la byin pa de skye ba/ lnga por yang mi spong ngo*/ /11de nas gzhan yang sbyor bar 'gyur ba/ zla ba gzas zin/ nye bar chags pa'i dus su sgrol ma'i gzungs zlos shing brten par rang gi phyag rgya snyoms 'jug

byas la/ de las byung ba'i 'jig rten dbang phyug blangs te/ dung gi bsregs pa'i/ thal ba dang mnye bar bya zhing rab gang dbang du bya ba/ tu grags ma nyid la byin te/ ji srid du skye ba/ lngar yang rjes gnas/ su 'brang ngo*/ /12de nas gzhan yang sbyor bar 'gyur ba/ sgrol ma'i gzungs kyis ma dā na myos byed/ pha la la po so 'cha'/ dha du ra 'bras bu/ lan brgya rtsa brgyad yongs su bzlas te/ 'dod myos byed kyi 'bras bu rang*/ pa'i 'bras bu des rta mgrin sih+la/ dang lhan cig pas bskus na dbang du 'gyur ro/ /13oṃ tā re tut+tā re tu re a mu ka che ge mo/ s+ya ban+dha bcings pa/ naṃ grol bar/ muk+ti ku ru mu mdzod cig swāhā/ zhes bya ba'i sngags 'dis ar+k+ka'i lo ma la bsgrub bya'i ming nang du chud par bris la | ne'u le'i khung bur sbas na bcings pa las grol bar 'gyur ro/ / ( 14 ) dang bstan no de nas blo 'phel ba'i thabs/ shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa'i 'byung gnas yang dag par rab tu bshad par bya'o/ / snying khar zla ba la aṃ bsam nas de'i 'od kyis spyan drangs nas mchod pa la sogs pa dang stong par bsgom pa'i bar kha bskang de nas paṃlas pad+ma a las zla ba la yi ge oṃ dkar po spro ba dang bsdu ba gcig tu gyur pa las rdo rje bzhi las bskyed/ gang gis bsgoms pa tsam gyis phas kyi rgol ba thams cad tshar bcad par 'gyur ro/ /lha mo phyag gnyis ma zhal gcig ma mdog dkar ba skyes pa'i/ yid 'phrog ma skra phyed du li ba/ chu skyes shin tu dkar ba la yang dag par gnas ma/ lag pa g.yas par pad+ma mdog dkar ba yang dag par bsnams pa/ bsgoms shing*/ g.yon na shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa 'i posti pad+ma dmar po'i steng du'o// rdo rje zla ba'i gdan la/ skyil krung du gnas pa/ rgyan thams cad kyis rnam par brgyan ma 'o zer/ lte ba'i dkyil 'khor du bsgom par bya'o/ / ste zer/ oṃ a zer*/ las skyes ma mchog tu dga' bar byed ma/

dam tshig sems ma phyi ma/ bskyed nas ye shes nang ma/ sems dpa' bsgom par bya zhing*/ rnal 'byor snying khar zla ba la gnas pa'i aṃ bsams la de la sngags kyi phreng ba me lce ltar 'bar ba kha nas dbyung zhing lte bar 'jug pa 'gal me ltar bsams la/ zla ba drug tu goms pas shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa ste shes rab rno ba ra 'gyur ro/ /mtshan zhag mo bdun du sbyor bas bstan de'i rnal 'byor byas na/ bcos thams cad shes par byed do | | 'bum bsnyen pa/ bzlas pa'i sbyor bas nyi ma re re la tshigs bcad brgya byed par 'gyur ro/ /rab tu 'bad pa med par gzhung brgya yang 'dzin par byed do// de la sngags kyi rkang par 'gyur ba/ oṃ

ras bal gyi 'dab ma dang 'dra bar phra mor 'bigs pa'i shes rab bskyed pa'o// pi tsu pi tsu pradzña bar+ngha ni/ bskyed pa/ dz+wa la 'od gsal ba 'bar bar byed| dz+wa la 'dzin blo/ me dhā bar+ngha ni/ bskyed pa/ dhi dal nas/ ri dhi brdar pa ste dran pa ma nyams pa/ ri bud+dha sangs rgyas kyi/ bar+ngha ni bskyed par/ swāhā/ khwa nang par/ mi zer na sngags bdun kan dzi la/ du mngon par bsngags par byas te/ gang la bzlas pa/ ma bslang ba'i sings po shing tog rang skyur/ skyur po la la sngags kyis gdab par bya zhing zer bde/ lan bdun bsngags la/ sngags kyis gdab par bya zhing ji srid zla ba drug tu gang 'thung ba de shes rab chen por 'gyur ro/ /de nas de lta bu'i dngos grub de bla ma la brten nas 'byung bas/ rdo rje slob dpon dbang bskur ba dang man ngag 'chad pa'i/ gyi/ /mtshan nyid yang dag bshad 'di dag snod rung dbang bskur dang gtso bor 'brel/ par bya/ /de yis nye bar bstan pa'i sngags/ / don dam pa'i brdar btags pa'i/ sgrub nyams su blangs na/ pa po yis nges dngos grub/ par 'grub/ /dal de kho na rtogs pa'am spyod lam dal ba rang la bya/ zhing zab de kho na/ mo'i chos rtogs pa/ dang ldan/ /rig pa 'i gnas lnga po/ thams cad mkhas par bcas/ /sbyin sreg dang*/ dkyil 'khor dang rtsa sngags la sogs pa'i/ sngags shes shing*/ /rab gnas dang*/ gtor ma'i pha don shes pas/ rol son/ /de bsrung ba'i 'khor lo'i de kho na dang*/ dbang bskur pa'i de kho na dang*/ gtor ma'i de kho na dang*/ bzlas pa'i de kho na dang | dgar ba'i de kho na dang*/ phyir zlog pa'i de kho na dang*/ dkyil 'khor bsgrub pa'i de kho na dang*/ sdig pa sbyong ba'i de kho na dang*/ bsdigs pa ste lha gnad la bor pa'i de kho na dang*/ gshegs su gsol pa'i de kho na dang bcu'o// nyid bcu ni rnam par rig /nyan thos spyod pa srung ba po/ / sngags kyi theg pa/ spyod pa la/ rim pa gus pa dang*/

/gzugs bzang po dang*/ ldan pas pha rol po/ mthong na dga' ba dang*/ /dkyil 'khor 'bri zhing bzlas par ldan/ /rtsa ba'i ltung dang yan lag gi dam tshig gnyis kas mi gos pas/ ba 'joms pa'o/ /sngags dang gzhan gyi/ lus skyob pa'i bsrung 'khor/ sbyor ba yis/ /'jig rten rnams ni bde bar byed | | mtshan nyid dam yon tan/ de de lta bu dang*/ ldan pa/ bla mar byas nas ni/ /gang slob ma | zhig gis/ bla ma smod byed mi smad zer/ cing*/ /skye bo bla ma la/ smod par byed/ pa gang*/ / dmyal rdo rje/ ba chen por 'tshed par 'gyur/ /ji de bas na/ ltar rdo rje bla ma/ 'dzin rgyal ba dang 'dra ba'i bla ma/ ni/ /sangs rgyas rnam snang sogs/ kun gyis kyang slob dpon la/ dang por mchod/ /rdo rje de bzhin du/ gur gyis sgor zhugs pa'i rnal 'byor pa la brten nas go 'phang khyad par can du/ 'gro ba yis/ /de ltar bla ma'i mchod pa la/ nan tan bya/ /bla ma'i grib ma bud med dang*/ /lham dang stan dang mal stan rnams/ /rmongs chen gang zhig 'gom byed pa/ /skyes pa de ni spu gri yis gtams pa'i lam la 'gro ba/ 'dzin// legs bla ma/ par bsnyen pa la sogs pa dang ldan pas/ dbang bskur slob ma gang*/ /bla dbang bskur ba'i/ ma'i 'aka' las 'da' byed pa/ /'jig rten 'dir ni 'on par 'gyur | | 'jig rten pha rol dmyal bar gnas/ /g.yo dang bla mas bsgo ba de nus bzhin du/ sgyu yi sbyor ba yis/ /brdzun bla mas bsgo pa las/ gyis mi nus smra ba las/ khong tshe 'dir/ skam mdze nad chen po can/ /dmyal pha rol tu/ ba la sogs skye bar 'gyur | | de ltar bka' bzhin ma byas na nyes pa 'byung bar/ shes pa'i slob ma yis/ /bla ma'i bsnyen bkur pha byed pa de/ rol 'gro/ /bla ma'i bka' ni rab bsrungs na/ / dngos grub phan yon/ rgyas pa 'grub par 'gyur/ /tshogs bsod nams 'phel ba dang mkha' 'gro ma mnyes pa'i ched du/ kyi zas ni rtag tu mchod par bya/ bya/

/zhi rdo rje slob dpon mnyes par bya ba'i phyir/ ba la sogs pa'i las la rab/ rtag tu bsgrub bskul/ /snga dro tshogs kyi mchod pa byed tsa na/ bar dge 'dun chos ston bya/ /bla ma sangs rgyas dang 'dra ba/ yang mnyes bya/ /bla ma la ni yon dbul zhing*/ /de'i rjes su 'khor du 'dus pa'i/ tshogs kun la'o/ /bdag gi las ni tshogs kyi 'khor lo/ brtsams nas ni/ /cho ga 'og nas kyi| 'dis gtor ma/ ni dngos grub/ bsgrub par bya/ /yan lag tha mal pa'i me tog la sogs pa| rgyan rnams kun gyis brgyan/ /rdo rje rgyan phyag rgya lnga/ gyis rnam par brgyan/ / rdo rje dril bu blangs nas ni/ /lam mkha' 'gro ma 'du sa/ gyi bzhi mdor gtor ma gtang | | me tog bdug spos mar me dang*/ /de bzhin dri yi dung sogs g.yas// g.yon du mchod yon gyi/ bzlas pa'i bzhes zhal/ mchod yon snod/ /mdun bzhes zhal/ du snod ni bzhag par bya/ / rgyud 'bum pa'i gnyis pa'i nang nas 'byung bas/ zhabs bsil gong ma'i cho ga yis/ /me tog spos sogs rim pa bzhin/ /lā s+ye la sogs mchod pa yis/ /mchod par byas na dngos grub/ bzang po sbyin/ /me tog bsgyur ba'i tshul gyis dang*/ /dri ni 'thor ba'i tshul gyis dang*/ /sdong mthe bong*/ po ltar byas pa| mar me'i mchod pa dang*/ /byug dri/ pa'i tshul/ lugs kyis rjes su dris/ / lā s+ye'i lag pas lā s+ye ste/ /phreng bas phreng ba'i mkha' 'gro ma/ /hūm̐ gis glu yi dam tshig glu/ /brla bskum g.yon pa'i gre mo g.yas su gzugs/ pas ni gar nyid de/ / mchod pa 'di rnams bla na med/ /sangs rgyas thams cad mnyes par byed/ / sangs rgyas rnams ni mchod pas mchod/ / de ltar byas na/ 'dod pa'i dngos grub byed par 'gyur/ /bzlas bsgrub pa'i mchod pa/ dang bsgom rim pa gnyis/ la mngon dga' zhing*/ /rtag tshogs kyi/ tu 'khor ba'i/ 'khor lo'i pha rol 'gro/ / ba'i bsam pa dang ldan/ rdo rje mkha' 'gro'i bka' ji bzhin/

/'di rnams bla med mchod pa'o// me 'o na tha mal pa'i mchod pa mchog ma yin nam/ zhe na/ tog spos sogs mngon sum du/ / 'jig rten spyod par gnas dbul ba'i rdzas dang yul la sogs pa/ pa yis/ /sna tshogs mchod pa mchog nyid min/ /de nyid byang chub yan lag min/ /dkar gong du zhi ba la sogs pa rab tu bskul ces pa'i las sgrub pa'i dus su thab gyi kha dog bstan gsung*/ po zhar la dkyil 'khor gyi kha dog bstan/ zhi bar byed pa brjod/ /ser las kyi dbye ba/ po rgyas pa'i sgrub thabs la/ /dbang dang dgug par dmar po che/ /tha ma'i las la nag po'o | | zhi ba la ni me tog dkar/ /ser po rgyas pa'i rdo rje la/ /me tog nag po tha ma la/ /dbang dang dgug pa dmar po bzang*/ /rnal 'bras bu'i rgyud du bsdu/ 'byor pa gang dbang bskur med/ / de ma thob pa dang*/ dkyil 'khor du ni ma zhugs dang*/ / gang zhig slob dpon du khas 'che ba de/ rab gnas kyi lag len/ ma mthong dang*/ /gang zhig sbyin sreg ma byas pa/ /'jig rten 'di dang pha rol du/ /de yi dngos grub mchog nyid med/ /gang gis dbang bskur ba dang rgyud bshad pa dang gdam ngag zhu bar/ slob dpon la/ gsol ma btab/ /'dir ni sngags spyod pa'i/ rigs su skye ba med/ / sangs bskyed rim gyis/ rgyas rnam snang la sogs pa/ thams cad bsgom par bya/ /gang de'i phan yon/ zhig byang chub tshe gcig gi bar du/ ma thob na/ /'khor lo sgyur ba'i gnas su de'i | | yang dang yang du/ skye zhing skye ba skye bar 'gyur/ /yang na khams kyi rgyal po/ sa yi bdag po nyid/ /dag pa'i gnas lngar/ su mngon par 'gro/ /bde ba can 'og min| dang mkha' grong dang*/ /dga' ldan du ni blo ldan skye/ / ( 2 ) 'jig rjes su mi mthun pa ste kun yang 'byung na mthun pa/ rten 'dir ni gang grub pa/ / ( 1 ) sangs rgyas de ( 3 ) ni ci zhig smos/ khams sangs rgyas kyi mtshan nyid/ gsum bdag kun 'gro'i dbang phyug yin pas/

po chen po nyid/ /'chi med rgas pas khyab pa med/ /tshangs pa brgya byin de bzhin drag / mahā de ba/ sgra gcan khyab 'jug me lha/ dang rlung lha/ dang ni/ / 'dod dga' rab dbang phyug pa'i lha dang thong ldan gang ba bzang po'i bu/ nyid/ /'dir rnams de yi 'khor du 'gyur/ /lha klu de bzhin gnod sbyin dang*/ /dri za lha ma yin dang mi/ /mi'am ci dang mkha' spyod rnams/ /de rnams 'khor gsum the tshom med/ /'di phyag rgya chen po'i dngos grub/ ni rang glo bur du ma byung ste dang po nas rang byung ngam dbang phyug la sogs pa'i rgyu las ma byung bas/ byung bcom ldan chos sku las gzugs skur sprul te/ 'das | | chos longs sprul gnyis ka la 'jug kyi 'khor lo bskor ba dang*/ / ( 5 ) rgyal po'i rigs la sogs par skye ba bzhes pa/ dang mngon par/ byang chub byed pa dang*/ / de bzhin du ni lhar dga' ldan gyi/ gshegs dang*/khyim nas 'byung bar byed pa dang*// rab tu byung ba 'dzin pa dang*/ /skye lhums nas bltam pa la sogs pa/ ba yongs su len pa lhums su zhugs pa dang*/ dang*/ /yongs su mya ngan 'das pa ston/ / gzhan yang 'dul gang la gang gis/ ba'i 'jig rten mthong nas ni/ / phyag rgya chen po thob pa 'di ni gzugs ni du ma byed/ /sangs rgyas sems sprul pa du mar/ can bskyab bzhed pas/ /sangs rgyas sprul pa du mas/ gar ni rol pa mdzad/ /ri bong sems can gyi don du/ stag dang seng ge dang*/ /glang po rnams kyi rigs su'ang/ /snying rje nga byams pa/ sa phan pa'i sems kyis ni/ /sangs rgyas chen po/ grub pa skye bar 'gyur/ /bud bud med kyis 'dul ba rnams la/ med sgyu ma'i spros pa yi/ /'dod chags can la chos gsung ngo*/ / bud med sgyu ma sangs rgyas nyid/ / du sprul nas/ gdul bya'i/ sgyu ma thams cad sel bar byed/ / phyi rol gyi shes rtags/ rab pha rol phyin gzugs su/ /bud med rtag tu yang dag gnas/ /sgyu yang na don gyis na de mi smad par bstan/

ma de bsten pas/ chen mo'i gnas 'dug nas/ /sangs rgyas byang chub rab tu ster/ / de'i mtshan nyid/ g.yo chags pa| zhing dad che ngo tsha 'i shas chung*/ med/ /rtag tu 'dod chags pha kyi skyon gyi ma gos te gnyis med ye shes su rtogs pa/ rol 'gro/ /phyag rgya chen po'i gnas 'dug lha'i skur bsgom pa nas/ /dngos grub kyang ni rab tu ster/ /gzugs bzang ba dang*/ dang yon tan che ba/ nor la yang*/ /'dod pa gang yang de lta bu/ btsun mo la/ med/ /rdo rje 'du shes gsum ldan gyis bsten pa/ 'dod chags yid rdo rje'am/ 'dod pas/ /rang gnyis su med pa'i ye shes su ngo shes pas/ gi bde ba myang bar ldan/ /skyes gnyis su med pa'i ye shes ngo shes pa de'i grogs mtshan nyid/ bu sdom pa'i/ tshul khrims gsum dang*/ ldan pa dang*/ /bde gshegs bka' thun mong ba'i pham pa brgyad/ las mi 'da' zhing*/ /bla ma la/ bsnyen bskur dang sems can la/ snying rje can/ /kye yi rdo rjes rab phye ba'o/ /de gong du le'u bdun par dbang gsungs pa de yang dkyil 'khor dang 'brel bas dkyil 'khor ji lta bar bya gsungs pas| nas rnal 'byor ma bdag med ma gtso mo dang mkha' spyan ma la sogs pa/ 'gro ma rnams kyis slob ma dbang bskur ba'i don du dkyil 'khor bri bar/ bstod pa'i rgyal po 'di gsol ba btab pa/ / slob dpon la rigs lnga'i sgo nas bstod pa/ sbyang gzhi zhe sngon dus drug pa rdo rje 'chang la bdag med ma la sogs pas rjes 'jug slob dpon la slob mas dkyil 'khor bri ba'i phyir bstod pa/ sdang rdo rje chos dbyings/ phyag 'tshal drug pa rdo rje 'dzin pa nyid rigs lnga po yin pas/ bstod | | gti sbyang gzhi/ mug me long*/ rdo rje phyag 'tshal bstod/ /ser sbyang gzhi/ sna rdo rjes mnyam nyid/ bdag la skyobs/ / rgyu/ 'dod chags so sor rtog pa/ rdo rjes bdag la stsol/ /yid phrag dog rdo rje nga rgyal te/ zer/ dang phrag dog chen po

bya ba grub pa/ dang*/ / rdo rje kun gyi rigs lnga'i lam 'bras mngon du gyur pa las mi 'da' bas/ dam tshig mgon/ / las bzhi po/ rnams mchog dang thun mong*/ thams cad sgrub pa po/ /rdo rigs lnga drug rje can kun gyi ngo bo dkyil 'khor bri ba'i sgo nas/ bdag dgyes mdzod/ /de nas bcom ldan 'das mkha' 'gro ma thams cad kyi dkyil 'khor bri ba'i phyir gsol ba btab ste/ dam tshig la gnas te/ dkyil 'khor ston pa'i/longs ma spyad par/ sar pa 'jur mdud med par mdzes par ldan/ /shin tu tshad ma nyis 'gyur/ gtsang ma yis/ /he mi bskyod pa bsdus pa'i dkyil 'khor gyi dbang du byas pa/ zhes bya ba'i dkyil 'khor gyi/ /shes rab can gnas/ gyis thig gdab par/ bya/ /de la 'og nas kyi byin gyis brlab pa'i skabs/ 'di ni slob ma chen po'i gsol ba gdab pa'i dam tshig go /de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi dngos gzhi/ zhi/ /de bzhin gshegs pa kun gyi gnas/ / sam go 'phang thob par byed pa'i| rdo rje sems dpa' yis gsung pa/ las byung ba'i/ /dkyil 'khor gyi phyir/ 'dren pas slob dpon gyis/ bshad du gsol/ /dkyil 'khor gyi phyir/ rdo rje slob dpon/ la gsol ba btab pa/ rnam par rgyal ba zhes bya ba'i ting nge 'dzin to/ /nga sa chog zur tsam/ ni snying rje'i stobs dpal ldan/ / dkyil 'khor gyi bar chad/ bsrung ba'i 'khor lo sbyor ba po/ /rdo rje yi 'od zer gyi/ sa ni gsal ba'i lus/ /sku gsum las ni skyes pa spro/ / gcig yin yang*/ gal te la la 'da' byed na/ /'jig lus/ par 'di la the tshom med/ /lus srul po dang kha cig gang ( ka ) / / ( ga ) bde ba/ chen po dang ldan pa'i| ye shes byung ba dang*/ /rdo rje sems dpa'i rang bzhin skyes/ / pa gcig bar chad byed kyang*/ ( kha ) zur cig bgegs ni chen po rnams ( ka ) / / ( nga ) 'khor thig gdab pa bstan| lo la cha chen bcu drug yi ni brgyad lha snam phan tshun la cha brgyad/

nyid kyi/ /cha yis sgo la brgyad cha gcig ste cha chen gcig tu/ ni rab tu grags/ /sgo khyud lha yi snam bu ni/ /sgo yi tshad kyis tshad cha chen gcig du bya/ /sgo yi phyed kyi cha chung gnyis/ cha ru ni/ /ya phubs dang ni 'gram nyid do/ /mchod snam nyid kyang de bzhin bya/ /drwa ba'i snam bu rig sgo phyed drwa ba drwa phyed do zer/ byed phyed/ / ( ga ) dang por tshangs pa'i thig dang ni/ /gnyis par mtshams kyi thig dang yang*/ /gsum par ngos bzhi yi ni thig bzhi/ /thig ni rab tu gdab par bya/ /tshangs nang gi pho brang gi thig nas/ cha chen/ gnyis bor nas ni// cha drug tu ni btab pa dang brgyad de spyir bcu drug go/

gdab par bya/ /de nas sgo yi lha snam gyi tshul/ tshad bor nas/ /dgu phyi'i dkyil 'khor dang ma 'byar par ston/ yi char ni nang du/ rab tu gdab/ / ( kha ) de la 'di ni sa 'i bgegs sam skyon/ sbyang ba'i dam tshig go /oṃ khaṃ hūṃ bruṃ sa nam mkhar rlob pa/ de la 'di ni ye shes bzhir brlab pa gsung*/ ye shes kyi thig spyan drangs pa ste/ oṃ me di ni badz+rī bha ba badz+ra bhān+dha ye shes kyi thig gis sa gzhi byin gyis brlab pa| hūm̐/ ( ca ) de la 'di ni thig gdab pa'i dam tshig ste/ oṃ sa mā ya sū tra ma ti kra ma hūm̐ | de la 'di ni rdul tshon bri ba'i dam tshig ste/ / rdul tshon gy-i 'di ni chos dbyings kyi ngo bo/ dag pa gzhal yas khang*/ ste/ /sems can khams ni thar bar byed/ /kye yi rdo rje rgyal po ches/ /dkyil 'khor dam pa bzhengs par bya/ /dbang ldan du ni sa ra seng ge'i bye brag sngon po/ bha/ /me yi mtshams su dge sbyong bri/ /chos kyi 'khor lo bden bral du/ /rlung du rdo rje bri bar bya/ /lcags kyu shar du bri bar bya/ /lho yi sgor ni zhags pa nyid/ /nub sgor de bzhin lcags sgrog ste/ /byang du rdo rje dril bu'o | | dbus su thod pa dkar po ni/ /sna tshogs rdo rjes mtshan pa bri/ / bsdus pa'i mtshan ma byin po yang go bar bya gsung*/ de nas sdig pa zhi bar bya ba dang lha mnyes par bya ba dang sngags kyi lhag chad kha bskang bar bya ba'i phyir/ rdo rje 'dzin pa'i rgyal pos/ sbyin sreg gi grong khyer rab tu phye ba/ rdo rje thab khung sbyor ba yis/ /rdo rje'i bsreg rdzas sbyor ba las/ /zlum po zhi bar byed par brjod/ /rgyas pa ra ba'i rdzing bu gzugs// dbang ni zla ba phyed pa 'dra/ /dgug pa la ni lcags kyu'i dbyibs/ /gsad dang zhe sdang las la ni/ /nam gru gsum/ mkha'i khams dang mtshungs pa'o/ /de bzhin skrod byed skal rmongs par byed pa la/ ngan dang*/ yan rengs par bya ba/

lag g.yo ba'i sbyor ba yis/ / la yang gru gsum/ shing*/ tsan+dan a ka ru shing dang*/ /gzhan yang dri yi rkang shing gi rtsa ba/ 'thung nyid/ /sbyin sreg yan lag mes sbar nas/ /phyis ni yang dam tshig gi me lha bskyed pa la sogs pa/ ni dgug par bya/ /oṃ e h+ye kye tshur spyon/ hi mahā bhū ta chen po 'byung po lha'i drang srong*/ de ba ri ṣi dwi skye gnyis/ dza bde bar snoms la/ san+ta ma gri hi dgang blugs 'di/'dir spyon/ twāṃ a hu ti mahā na mā smin+sa ni hi to bha ba/ lcags ye shes kyi lha spyan drangs pa de/ kyu nyid kyis dgug par bya/ /zhags pa nyid kyis dgug bya zhing*/ / lcags sgrog gis ni zhabs dag bcing*/ /dril bu 'khrol bas dbang du dam tshig pa dang ye shes pa gnyis su med par bstims pa de la/ byas/ /lā s+ye la sogs mchod brgyad dang | | mchod yon cho gas byas nas ni/ /mar la sogs pa'i sbyor ba las/ / yang ni me ni mnyes par bya/ /de la 'di ni rdo rje mchod yon gyi dam tshig ste/ oṃ pra ba ra sat+kā ra pra tīts+tsha swāhā/ de la 'di ni zhabs bsil gyi dam tshig ste/ oṃ sarba pā paṃ da ha na badz+ra ya badz+ra sa twa s+ya sarba pā paṃ da ha swāhā/ de la 'di ni bsreg rdzas thams cad 'chu ba'i dam tshig gi sngags te/ oṃ badz+ra rdo rje/ a nā la me/ ma hā chen po/ bhū ta 'byung po/ dz+wa la sbor/ ya/ sarba thams cad/ bhasmi ku thal bar mdzod/ ru sarba thams cad/ duṣ+tan ma rungs pa/ hūm̐ phaṭa/ dṛ sha dzaḥhūm̐ baṃ hoḥs ma ya s+t+waṃ haṃ/ phyi nas rang 'dod pa'i lha spyan drangs pa ste/ dang por thab khung du dam tshig gi 'khor lo bskyed/ oṃ e h+ye hi bha ga ye shes lha/ wān+ni ha bha k+t+ya na sa dam tshig ma ye na dngos po/ tsa argan+taṃ sa ti ts+tshe taṃ pū dzāñtsa dwa mchod pa la sogs pa/ pra si da me/ de la 'di ni dgyes par byed pa'i dam tshig ste/ oṃ kri ti wa sarba satwār+tha sidhi rdat+ta ya thā nu gā gats+tshan+dha bud+dha bi sha yaṃ pū na rā ga ma nā ya muḥ

khyod kyis sems can don kun mdzad/ /ji lta'i rjes su dngos grub stsal// sangs rgyas yul du gshegs nas kyang*/ /slar yang gshegs par mdzad du gsol// gzhengs zhu ba la glus bskul bas/ pa dang sgrol ma'i/ las sna tshogs kyi sbyor ba dang sbyin sreg gi le'u ste brgyad sho lo ka brgya lnga bcu rtsa dgu yod do// pa'o// //de rtsa ba'i rgyud kyi rab gnas kyi don cung zad bstan par 'gro/ nas rdo rje 'dzin rgyal gyis// rdo rje sems dpa'i yis gsungs pa/ rab gnas ni/ /'jig rten don dam thams cad lha yin pas byar med kyang*/ tha snyad la gnas te/ / gnas pa dang bral ba sbros bral gyi ngo bo/ mdor bsdus nas ni bstan par bya/ /dang bdag nyid/ por re zhig rig ma dang ldan par bsgom| 'dzin/ /dril bum par lha yab yum tshan lnga bskyed/ rab tu gnas pa'i lha la snyan gsan dbab pa'i phyir/ bu 'khrol bar 'dod pa dang*/ /rkang g.yas dang po de ltar phyis ci bder 'dug brkyang pa'i sbyor ba las/ /g.yas pas rdo rje gsor ba dang*/ /srod tho rangs| thun skad ni chag pa dang*/ /gos kyis mgrin pa bcings pa dang*/ /rin chen sman gyis yongs gang ba'i/ / bum par lha yab yum tshan pa lnga bskyed pa la bzlas rten la bkug la bzlas so// bum pa sta gon gnas par bya/ /oṃ yab yum/ de ba pi tsu badz+ra a dbus kyi bum par/ dhi tiṣ+ṭha/ oṃ mo gti mug dga' ma/ hā ra t+ti a t+ti mnos shig tiṣ+ṭha/ oṃ dwa zhe sdang dga' ma/ ṣa ra ti a dhi lhag par mnos shig tiṣ+ṭha/ oṃ rā 'dod chags dga' ma/ ga ra ti a t+ti tiṣ+ṭha/ oṃ badz+ra rdo rje dga' ma/ ra ti a dhi tiṣ+ṭha/ oṃ badz+ra gau rī ā kar+ṣa dam tshig pa tshan pa lnga bskyed de de la ye shes pa dgug pa/ ya dzaḥ oṃ badz+ra tsau rī pra we sha ya hūm̐/ oṃ badz+ra be tā lī bhan+dha baṃ/ oṃ badz+ra ghasma rī wa shaṃ ku ru hoḥ'adi ni ye shes dgug pa'i cho ga'o | | shun dang la mar nag gis byug de nas pa ṭa dang*/

u dum wa ra la sogs pa de nas skyu ru ra de nas yang dri zhim pos byug go / pa lnga dang ba byung 'o ma zho mar chu lci ba/ lnga/ khyad par du yang tsan+dan gnyis/ gur gum ga pur dzā ti de/ dri lnga dang*/ /lus rab tu gnas pa bya ba'i rgyu/ can la ni blugs par bya/ /mchod yon la ni sngon le'u brgyad pa nas 'byung ba/ bzhin bya/ / yang dngos gzhi'i dus su lhag par gnas pa bzhin/ ni de nyid sbyor slob dpon lha'i rnal 'byor dang ldan pas/ bar bya/ /snga dro/ bar shun pa sogs kyis/ blugs shing byin gyis brlab/ /mig bdag med pa'i ting nge 'dzin sngaun du 'gro bas so so'i lha bskyed pa'i/ la sogs par gti mug sogs | | rdo rje gsum ni gnas gsum ye shes kyi 'khor lo dgug gzhug bya dgod/ / dbang bskur ba/ ni rang gi rigs kyi bdag po/ nyid kyis/ / mtshan/ mchod rab tu gnas pa byas pa'i rjes la/ pa la sogs rim pas brtsam/ / dbang bskur ba'i/ rnal 'byor pa rab tu gnas pa byas pa' ི rang snying gnas su ye shes kyi lha/ bsam/ /sangs rgyas bzhugs par bsam la bdud rtsis/ bsang gtor bya/ / snying kha nas ye shes bdud mchod pa'i/ rtsi'i ye shes kyi gnas te sems dpa' lngas mtshon pa ste dri yis mchod/ sbyor ba yis/ /rim mi bskyod pa'i rnal 'byor yin na hūm̐ las lha mo brgyad spros la/ pas mchod pa'i lha mo spro/ /byang rab gnas kyi lha de nyid/ chub sems mchog stong pa dang ye shes gnyis su med pa'i ngo bor/ bsams nas ni/ / snying kha'i sa bon las 'od spros nas/ sangs rgyas la/ bstod pa yang dag brtsam// dngos don dam par/ po kun gyi rang bzhin gyis/ / bstod pa bya ba'i yul dang bstod pa dang*/ bstod par byed pa'i gang zag gsum ka stong pa snying rje tha dad med/ / par bsams nas/ khyod ni rnal 'byor ma tshogs yongs su bskor/ khyod de nyid thugs su chud pa'i/ ni nyid kyi thugs kyis mchog chos sku'i dngos grub/

brnyes pa/ khyod sprul sku gzhan don gyi sgo nas/ kyis rgyu dang ba lha/ mi rgyu'i ba gzhal yas khang du/ 'gro ba kun bsgrubs shing*/ / dmigs pa med pa'i snying rje'i thugs kyis sems can 'khor ba las/ sad par/ mdzad pa/ /sgyu ma'i gang la gang gis 'dul ba de la der ston pas/ spros pas rdo rje 'phen mdzad pa/ /he ru ka dpal rdo rje zag med gsum gyi nyams su bstar ba/ yid kyis dgyes/ / bstod pa'o//bdud rtsi myang ba/ rdo rje se gol brdab pa tsam gyi/ sbyor ba yis/ / skad cig ma las rdo rje sems dpa' zer/ sgom gnyis su med pa'i ye shes kyi snang ba yin pas/ pa bsgom par lhag pa'i lha/ bya/ /rdo rje gnyis su med pa'i ye shes kyi snang bar gyur pas/ yi ge yaṃ/ blangs nas ni/ / rlung gi rdo rje dkyil 'khor bsgom par bya/ / rlung gi rdo rje dkyil 'khor dbus gnas par/ /rdo rje phung po raṃ/ rnam par sgom/ /de nas rdo rje 'tshed par bsam/ /rdo rje lce yi rang gi lce hūm̐ las rdo rje rtse lnga par bskyed pa/ sbyor ba las/ /sangs ye shes pa'i bdud rtsi'am snying kha'i/ rgyas rdo rje'i rjes bcug nyid/ /rdo rje'i sngags oṃ ā hūm̐ gsum gyis bdud rtsir/ kyis bsang gtor bya/ /bcom ldan 'das kyis rdo rje bdud rtsi ro myang ba'i rdo rje de skad ces bka' stsal to/ / le'u lnga par mdor bstan pa'i don 'dir rgyas par bshad/ nam mkha'i khams bskyed rim yan lag drug thun bzhir bsgrubs kyang dngos grub mi ster na thun bzhir bsgrub par bya/ kyi dbus chos 'byung*/ son par/ /rtse mo pan tsakra ces pa'i sgra las rigs lnga bsgom par yang 'gro yang na de rdo rje/ lnga pa sgom/ bris smad phur bur 'dug pa/ pa yis/ /sangs rgyas dang thun mong gi yang*/ dngos grub 'dod pa yis/ /stobs sangs rgyas dang phur bu bdag gsum ka mi dmigs par byas la/ kyis sangs rgyas phur bus gdab/

/chos rang 'od kyi rig ma'i chos 'byung du me'i dkyil na gnas par bsam/ 'byung grong khyer yid 'ong bar/ / g.yas pa stod rtse mo lnga pa smad phur bur 'dug pa 'dzin pa g.yon pa sdigs mdzub can no/ / rdo rje sdigs pa'i| mdzub mo'i sbyor ba las/ /gal te dngos grub mi ster na/ /rdo rje sems dpa'ang gsad par bya/ / ṭu ru ṭu ru zer/ oṃ du ru du ru brod gcig gnyis/ tshīn+da tshīn+da/ hūm̐ hūm̐ | bcom ldan 'das kyis phur bus gdab pa chen po rdo rje de skad ces bka' bstsal to/ /ma mo'i rigs lnga'i ngo bo mi gsal ba gsal bar bstan/ me'i dkyil 'khor de'i steng du a las thod pa/ de las ā li kā li g.yas skor dang g.yon skor/ de'i steng du bdud rtsi lnga dang sha lnga/ de'i steng du oṃ/ de'i steng du rdo rje rtse lnga pa lte bar hūm̐/ de las 'od 'phros pas ba dan la phog ba dan gyis rlung bskul rlung gis me sbar/ mes thod pa bsros/ de'i rlangs pa rdo rje la phog pas 'od 'phros te de bzhin gshegs pa'i thugs su zhugs pas he ru ka zhal gcig phyag gnyis pa g.yas na rdo rje g.yon thod pa bdud rtsis gang ba thogs pa bkugs te rdo rje la thim zhing rdo rje de nyid kyang thod par lhung bas zhu ste oṃ las bdud rtsi bsil ba gcig babs pas tsha ba'i ngad bsal oṃ āḥhūm̐ gis byin gyis brlab bo// dkyil 'khor pad+ma ma mo sogs/ dbus gnas par/ /rta 'od dpag med/ mgrin rnam byang chub pa lnga las| par bsgom par bya/ /dbu rgyan la ni rdo rje chos/ /phyag rgya chen po'i sbyor ba las/ /pad rdo rje chos kyi spyi bo na phyag mtshan/ ma dmar po spyi bor 'dzin/ /sku mdog dmar po stobs po che/ /gos dkar mo dang*/ gnyis med sbyor ba yis/ /bcu drug phyag gis rnam par brgyan/ /g.yas pa'i zhal ni nag po ste/ /g.yon pa zla mdzes dri ma med/ /dang por dmar por shes par bya/

/lhag ma'i zhal ni bung ba mtshungs | | zhal brgyad pa la zhabs bzhi pa/ /rdo rje chos ni gzi brjid che/ / 'dod chags chen po rjes chags pas/ /bdud bzhi mnyam par gnaXs pa po/ / ma mo'i skam pa ma la sogs/ dkyil 'khor dbus gnas par/ /rdo rje rnam snang dran par bya/ /dbu rgyan rdo rje 'dzin rnam snang*/ par bsam/ /sku mdog dkar po gzi brjid che/ /phyag ni bcu drug zhal brgyad dang*/ zhabs bzhi pa ste 'jigs pa po// chos rdo rje 'dzin pa'am rnam snang gi spyi bor/ kyi 'khor lo spyi bor 'dzin/ /'dod spyan ma/ chags chen po rjes chags pas/ /spyan ma/ dang gnyis med sbyor ba yis/ / 'jigs pa'ang ni 'jigs par mdzad/ /dang po'i zhal ni dkar po ste/ /nag po dmar pos rnam par brgyan/ /lhag ma'i zhal ni bung ba mtshungs/ /ma nyi lag ma sogs pa/ mo'i dkyil 'khor dbus gnas par/ /rdo rje nyi ma rnam par bsgom/ / cod pan 'dod don thams cad 'byung bas/ rin chen 'dzin 'byung ldan/ pa bsam/ /rdo rje gzi brjid 'od chen po/ /phyag ni bcu drug zhal brgyad pa/ /zhabs bzhi pa ste 'jigs pa po/ /sems kyi rin chen rin 'byung gi spyi bor 'dzin/ /btso ma gser ltar gzi brjid che/ /dang po'i zhal ni ser po ste/ /g.yas pa sngon po 'dra ba'o// g.yon pa zla 'od bzang po ste/ /lhag ma'i zhal ni bung ba mtshungs/ /ma mo'i sgo lcags ma la sogs/ dkyil 'khor dbus gnas par/ /rta mchog rnam par bsgom par bya/ /dbu rgyan don yod grub pa/ ral gri 'dzin pa bsam/ /margad ut+pal mtshungs pa'o/ /zhal brgyad pa la zhabs bzhi pa/ /bcu drug phyag gis rnam par brgyan | | dang po'i zhal ni sngo ljang khu zer/ bsangs te/ /rta yi gzugs rgod/ te 'jigs pa'o/ /g.yas pa kha dog nag po ste/ /g.yon pa zla mdzes dri ma med/ / ral gri dngos grub spyi don grub kyi/ bor 'dzin/ /lhag ma'i zhal ni bung ba mtshungs | | rdo rje nyi ma rta nyid kyi/

/ yon tan dang phrin las la bsdus nas phyag rgya 'di ni sgrol ma'i gzugs/ /lha mo rnams ni phyag gnyis brjod/ /gri gug dang ni thod pa nyid/ /kye dkyil 'khor gyi yon/ rdo rje 'i la dkyil ral gri 'khor mchog/ chos dbyings ye shes kyi rtog pa gcod pas/ ral gri dag ni brtag pa nyid/ /phan par me long dang mthun/ de bzhin no/ /rta mgrin la ni gos reg bya dag pas/ bzang ste/ /rdo rje nyi ma la ni yon tan rin chen lta bu yin pas/ gser/ /rta mchog nyid la 'gro sems can gyi don la brtson pas/ mgyogs te/ /mchog slob ma rang la/ tu phan pa ra byed pa/ nyid kyi yon/ / sangs rgyas 'bras bu 'dod pa yis/ /bla ma la rtag rgyun du dbul/ /skal de ltar 'bul ba'i rgyu mtshan/ bzang rdo rje rdo rje slob dpon rigs lnga'i ngo bo yin pas/ sems dpa' bdag | skal bzang thub pa rnam snang mdzad/ /skal bzang dpal ldan 'jig rten dbang*/ /skal bzang

rdo rje/ nyi ma dang rta/ bdun rgyal po 'i ngo bo yin pas yon dbul lo| |rigs bsdus pa'i dkyil 'khor bsdus pa'i sngags bstan/ de nas rdo rje 'dzin pa'i rgyal po 'i ngo bo yin pa yon dbul/ sku gsum mchog gi rdo rje 'dzin pa pos/ mi bskyod pa'i rnal 'byor thun bzhi'i rnal 'byor bsgoms kyang dngos grub stsol bar mi mdzad na/ mnga' bdag rdo rje sems dpa'i dam tshig gi mchog gsungs pa/ oṃ thugs kyi snying po bskul bar/ dha ra dha ra/ bstan/ dha ra bshad/ ya dha zung shig gnyis/ ra ya/ man+dh+ra ma mi snang bar gyis shig gnyis/ n+dh+ra/ badz+ra gnyis su med pa'i rdo rje 'dzin pa/ dhṛg phaṭa swāhā/ de nas sngags chen bshad pa na// rdo rje las/ skye ba sa sam gnyis med ye shes snang ba las/ snying rje che/ /'jigs thugs kyi snying po bskul bas/ shing skrag par gyur nas ni/ /rdo rje mi bskyod pa 'i dngos grub rab tu stsol/ /de nas bcom ldan 'das drug pa rdo rje 'dzin pa/ rdo rje chos kyi rnam pa'i ting nge 'dzin la snyoms par zhugs te/ rta dngos grub mi ster na thugs kyi snying po bskul ba/ mgrin gyi sngags 'di gsungs pa/ oṃ rdo rje chos/ badz+ra dharma sa mā gdul bya sems can la rjes su chags pas lta ba de 'da' bar mi bya bas dam tshig go/ ya s+t+waṃ/ hu lu hu lu/ a ro lika phaṭa | de nas 'di ni bshad tsam na/ /rdo rje chos ni grags chen po/ /'jigs shing skrag par gyur nas ni/ /chos kyi 'od dpag med kyi/ dngos grub rab tu stsol/ / de nas bcom ldan 'das rnam par snang mdzad rdo rje zhes bya ba'i ting nge 'dzin la snyoms par zhugs te/ phan pa'i sngags 'di gsungs pa/ oṃ rtag pa/ swā shwā ta/ pa ra chos sku/ ma swā mchog tu dga' ba ste longs spyod/ shwā ta/ e h+ye tshur spyon/ hi/ dzi na rgyas pa ste rtsibs bcu pa'i 'khor lo bdud las rgyal ba'i rtags su'o// dzika phaṭa/ de nas 'di ni bshad tsam gyis/
