/sangs rgyas kun dang de bzhin gshegs/ /brgyal zhing 'jigs par gyur nas ni/ /de rnams sangs rgyas rnam snang gi dngos grub stsol/ /de nas bcom ldan 'das rin chen nyi ma zhes bya ba'i ting nge 'dzin la snyoms par zhugs te/ rdo rje gzi brjid kyi sngags 'di gsungs pa/ oṃ rdo rje nyi ma/ badz+ra sur+ya ta mo nga rgyal gyi dbye ba drug gi mun pa sel/ bhi dha mahā sa ma ya mnyam pa ste sangs rgyas thams cad dang ngo*// s+t+waṃ haṃ rat+na dhṛg bsam pa thams cad rdzogs par byed pa'i rin po che 'chang ba/ phaṭa swāhā/ de nas 'di ni bshad tsam gyis/ /rdo rje gzi brjid 'od po che/ /'jigs shing brgyal bar gyur nas ni/ /nyi ma'i dngos grub rin 'byung gi rab tu stsol/ /de nas bcom ldan 'das don yod rdo rje zhes bya ba'i ting nge 'dzin la snyoms par zhugs te/ rta mchog rdo rje'i sngags 'di gsungs so/ / oṃ yod pa'ang snang*/ phuḥphuḥphuḥ hi hi hi rang bzhin gyi brda skad/ rab tu 'byed pa'i shes rab mtshon par byed pa'i ral gri 'dzin/ pradzñā dhṛg swāhā/ de nas 'di ni bshad tsam gyis/ /rdo rje don yod rigs byung ba/ / 'jigs shing brgyal bar gyur nas ni/ /de rnams don yod dngos grub stsol/ / rdo rje ra ba dang me'i phyi rol/ sangs yang na gzhal yas khang gi nang*/ yang na lha re re'i gdan no// rgyas dkyil lus kyi dkyil 'khor/ 'khor dkyil nyid de/ /rdo rje 'od dpag med/ can gyi zla phyed mtshungs/ / shes rab ye shes kyi dbang*/ rdo rje chos kyi pad+ma 'dra/ / dag pa'i sgo nas bstan| nyi ma'i yid 'di yang mthar thug gi dag pa zur dgu pa'i nang du/ bzhin nor bu bzhin// rta mchog zhes bya de yi ni/ /thams cad du ni gru gsum 'di yang mthar thug gi dag pa'i dbang du byas pa/ mo/ /rdo rje mi bskyod pa/ sems dpa'i phyag rgya mā ma kā ི che/ /phan pa'i phyag rgya nyid dang spyan/ ni/ /rdo rje chos kyi phyag rgya che/

/ gos dkar mo/ rin chen tog gi 'od sgrol ma/ byed ma/ /don yod grub pa'i phyag rgya che/ / las kyi sgrol ma/ rus pa'i phyag rgya rnams ni gong du bstan pas de'i rgyan bstan/ rgyan gyis brgyan par ldan/ /stag gi lpags pa mnabs pa dang*/ dbu skrar zla ba phyed pas/ thod gyen du ma 'dres rdzais zer/ pa phyed pa/ pa ste// brgyan pa/ mchod snyoms par 'jug pa sgrub pa'i/ par chos kyi 'du shes/ brtson pa'i sems dpa' yis/ /chags bde ba chen po la/ pas mig dmar mthong nas ni/ /phyag rgya chen po'i yum lhar bskyed pa'i/ sbyor ba las/ /chags pa'i sbyor bas bsgoms par bya | | las sna tshogs sgrub pa'i le'u ste sho lo ka lnga bcu nga lnga'o// dgu pa'o// //de nas rdo rje 'dzin rgyal gyis/ / rang gi sems kyi brtan g.yo brtag pa dang*/ dngos grub thob pa'i yul dang grogs dbang du bya ba dang sems can smin par bya ba'i phyir/ spyod pa'i mtshan nyid bshad par bya/ / dam tshig dang mi ldan pas rtogs par dka' bas rdo rje gnyis med ye shes kyi ngo bo yin pas spyod pa'i sbyor ba yis/ /rdo rje phyag rgya la brten nas spyod pa/ yang dag brtsam | | me spyod pa'i gnas/ tog 'bras sogs kyis brgyan pa'i/ /nags tshal chen po'i mtha' nyid du/ /sems srid pa gsum mnyam par rtogs pa'i rnal 'byor/ dpal chen po 'gro bar 'gyur/ / de'i kha zas ji lta bu zhe na nags tshal du ni slong mos rgyu/ / zas ni bzang po brgyan pa nyid/ /de shing gi lha/ rnams 'di ni nus pa thob pa yin pas ma byin na gnod pa byas te 'ong zhes/ 'jigs shing skrag nas ster/ /nags tshal bdag mi ma yin pa po'i rigs kun ni/ /rdo rje can de'i 'khor du 'gyur/ / mngon shes drug las lnga 'jig rten pa dang thun mong zag pa zad pa'i mngon shes ni 'das pa'o// skyes pa sngar/ dang ni skye da ltar| ba kun/ /skye skye mched byin gyis brlabs pas da lta tha mal pa'i rtog pa spang ba dang bar chad kyis mi tshugs/

lan gcig bo gang zhig phyir/ skye 'gyur ba/ /gti da ltar gyi mig mug rdo rje ra bskyed pa 'i sbyor ba las/ /rdo rje mig lan gcig lha'i mig gis mngon par shes pa thob tsam na/ gis mthong bar 'gyur/ khams gong ma gsum po mthong*/ gsum lam ni nyams dga' bar/ /sgra ni gang zhig rab grags pa/ /rna ba'i drung du gnas pa bzhin// zhe da lta ba rna ba sdang rdo rje ra bskyed pa/ 'i sbyor ba las/ / lan gcig rna ba'i mngon shes thob/ drang srong mngon par lha'i mig dang rna ba'i mngon shes dang po gzhan gyi rnam grangs shes pa gnyis/ shes pas thos//sems can kun gyi sems chen 'dod chags dang bcas pa la sogs pa/ po// mtshon rtogs/ dka' lta bu 'di 'dod chags dang bcas pa zhes la sogs pa/ 'i mtshan nyid ni// lag mthil du/ skyu ru ra lnga bzhag pa/ bzhin/ / gsal ba/ rdo rje'i yid bdag med par bskyed pas gzhan gyi sems shes pa thob tsam na/ sems kyis shes par 'gyur/ /skye sngon gyi gnas rjes su dran pa dang 'chi 'pho ba dang skye ba shes pa gnyis 'dis so/ / ba bye ba stong phrag tu/ / skyes pa rnams/ rang de'i phan yon sngon gyi gnas dran pa 'di yang yin/ gi rigs ni stong phrag gcig /rdo rje sbyor bas dran yid bdag med pa dran pa/ 'gyur te/ /nyi ma gsum lon pa/ bzhin gsal bar/ dran par 'gyur/ /sgyu sna lce lus gsum byin gyis brlabs pa'i phan yon rdzu 'phrul gyi yul shes pa thob/ 'phrul drwa ba du rdzu 'phrul gyi mngon shes lnga pa gcig tu gyur cing mang por gyur pa zhes sogs/ ma yis/ /'dis ni snang bar byed par 'gyur/ /mngon shes lnga'i don bsdus| lnga yi sbyor ba yis/ /sangs zag pa zag pa'i dag pa'o// rgyas mngon shes thob par 'gyur/ /rdo rje skye mched rnam par dag pa'i le'u ste tshigs bcad brgyad dang rkang pa gsum mo// bcu pa'o// // lha gang gi rnal 'byor gyis las bya ba bstan phan pa shes pa'i lha/

nyid kyis zhi ba ste/ /rdo rje nyi ma rgyas pa'o/ /rdo rje chos kyis dbang zhes bya/ /rdo rje sems dpas gsad par bya/ /zhi bar bya ba las dang*/ ba'i sems kyis zhi ba ste/ / zhi bar bya rgyu nad pa lta bu la bdud rtsi'i rgyun gyis spyi bo nas/ dbang ni yang dag brtsam par bya/ / tshe sogs rgyas pa'i dga' ba'i/ sems kyis rgyas pa ste/ / bum pa ser bos dbang bskur bas bsam pa yang gsung*/ rdo rje rin chen zer/ char sprin ltar 'bab pa/ rab tu/ bsgom par/ bya/ /rjes gang dbang du bya rgyu la| su chags pa'i sems kyis ni/ / dbang du bya ba/ bu mo bkug nas bza' bar bya// me yi char kha ba 'dzag pa lta bu'i/ sprin 'bab pa dang*/ /gdug mi bskyod pa'i rnal 'byor la gnas te/ pa'i sems kyis mahā de wa/ gsad par bya/ /'phrog dbang du bya ba'i rgyas bshad/ pa'i dbang phyug las chus byung gi bu mo lnga/ ni u ma/ dkar mo ste/ /skye gnyis tshangs pa/ pa las tshangs ma nyid/ / dgug dpal mo chus byung bu mo ste de yang legs smi/ sred med bu las kyang*/ / khyab 'jug ma in+d+ra/ bcag pa las brgya byin gyi chung ma/ ram bha nyid/ / thig le mchog rab tu dga' ma sdig can gyi chung ma/ chu srin lag tu/ rgyal mtshan dang po khyer bas sdig can| las/ / so so'i lha bskyed pas/ phyag de ltar bkug pa de tshul ji ltar bsten na/ rgya chen po'i sbyor ba yis/ /de rnams thams cad nye bar longs spyad par/ bza'/ /shin de rnams dang*| tu dga' ba'i sems kyis rtse/ /'dod log par g.yem pa'i nyes pa/ pas gos par mi 'gyur ro/ / gnyis su med pa'i ye shes kyi ngo bor shes pas spyad/ mthar ni swāhās zhi ba ste// rgyas pa'i dus su bau ṣa ṭa/ /mthar ni hūm̐ phaṭa gsad pa la/ /dbang du dgug la dzaḥdang hrīḥ las thams cad pa'i le'u sho lo ka drug dang rkang pa gsum mo/ / ste bcu gcig pa'o// // de nas rdo rje 'dzin rgyal ni/ /mkha' 'gro ma yi rdo rje gur/

/ ston pa po/ dgos ched/ rdo rje mkha' 'gro rab bsgrub mi bskyod pa gsung*/ phyir/ /thub pas tshig 'di bka' stsal to/ /me tog gnas bstan/ 'bras bus brgyan pa dang*/ /ri khrod ri bo'i gnas na gnas pa'i bkod pa/ dang ni sman ljongs su/ /rdo rje bsam gtan gyi khang pa tsan+dan la sogs pa'i dris byug par bde ba'i stan la/ skyil krung bcas nas ni/ /bla rang gi snying kha'i sa bon gyis 'od kyis/ ma sangs rgyas mchod par bya/ /dkon mchog gsum la rten du bzung ba tsam| bdag skyabs mchi/ /sdig pa thams cad so sor yan lag dang po/ bshags/ / gcig pa dang*/ 'gro ba'i mtshon pa tsam ste bud+dha bo dhi nyan rang*/ dge la rjes yi rangs/ / gnyis pa| sangs rgyas byang chub yid don mi dmigs pa ste gsum pa/ kyis bzung*/ /sangs rgyas chos dang tshogs mchog la/ /byang chub bar du skyabs su mchi/ / skyabs 'gro ste bzhi pa/ rang gzhan don ni rab bsgrub phyir/ /byang chub sems ni bskyed par bgyi/ / byang chub sems can thams cad 'gro bar bya ba'i bsam pas/ mchog gi sems ni bskyed bgyis nas/ /sems can thams cad bdag gis mgron du smon pa lnga pa/ gnyer/ / byang chub spyod mchog yid 'ong spyad par 'jug pa ste drug pa/ bgyi/ / mkha' 'gro ma rdo rje gur gyi lam rgyud la bsten pa/ 'gro la phan phyir sangs rgyas 'grub par shog / bdun pa bsngo ba/ tshangs pa'i gnas ni bzhi po yis/ / bde ba dang ldan pa dang sdug bsngal dang bral bar bya ba'i sgo nas/ sems can/ kyi sems la/ ngal ni bso bar bya/ /phyi nas ye shes kyi tshogs stong pa/ byang chub sems gnas te/ /de rjes bsrung ba'i dam tshig go / mdor/ rgyas bden snang tshod/ dang brdzun rigs pas dpyad na/ par spyad pa yis/ /brtags sgro skur gyi/ pas nye bar mi gos te/ /ma don dam pa stong par bsam pa/ skyes pa yi sbyor ba 'i ngang las chu klung dang ba las nya 'phar ba bzhin/ yis/ /skye ba

de'i ngang las kun rdzob tu/ 'dir ni rab tu brjod/ /oṃ shū n+ya tā dzñā na badz+ra swa bhā ba āt+ma ko3 haṃ/ nam mkha'i khams stong pa nyid/ kyi dbus gnas par/ /sna der bruṃ las 'khor lo rtsibs bcu pa der pad+ma dang nyi ma'i steng du hūm̐ las/ tshogs rdo rje kha gyes pa lte ba la hūm̐ gis mtshan pa las spros pas ra dang gur ro// bsgom par bya/ /hūm̐ ni bcu sna tshogs rdo rje'i steng du nas gang tsam gyis ma reg par 'khor lo rtsibs bcu pa bsams la de la/ yi sbyor ba yis/ khro bo bcu ni rim pas dgod// gshin rje mthar sngon po/ byed shes rab dkar po/ mthar/ /pad+ma mthar dmar po/ byed bgegs sngo/ mthar byed/ / sngon po ste go rim bzhin dang*/ tho ba dang*/ dbyug pa dang*/ pad+ma dang*/ rdo rje gdengs po thogs pa thung zhing gsus pa che ba sbrul gyi rgyan gyis brgyan pa skra kham pa gyen du 'bar ba mig dmar la zlum pa/ stag gi sham thabs can rnam snang dang mi bskyod pa dang*/ 'od dpag med dang*/ yang mi bskyod pas dbu brgyan pa'o// ṭāk+ki mer/ khro bo dbyig bden bral du/ pa sngon/ /mi g.yo dbang ldan du/ ba ral gri thogs pa/ dang stobs rlung du/ chen dang*/ / rtse gsum thogs pa/ gtsug steng du/ tor 'khor lo sgyur ba/ gdugs ni dkar po dang*/ / 'og tu rdo rje zhabs 'og gnas pa nag po/ ni/ /bdud bsrung ba'i 'khor lo/ rtsi'i rnal 'byor pa rang*/ sbyor las/ bas bskyed| thams cad phyogs bcu po/ du/ khro bo'i bcu bskyed pas/ sgom pas bsgom par bya/ / dpag tshad brgyar ni khyab pa ru/ / shin tu 'khor bar/ bsams nas bgegs ni bskrad par bya/ /nam bsrung ba'i 'khor lo'i nang du chos 'byung*/ mkha'i khams kyi dbus gnas par/ /rdo rje yaṃ las rlung*/ dkyil 'khor bsgom par bya/ /rdo rje'i dkyil 'khor dbus gnas par/ /'od kyi raṃ las me/ dkyil 'khor bsgom par bya/ /me yi dkyil 'khor dbus gnas par/

/yang ni baṃ las/ chu ni bsgom par bya/ /chu yi dkyil 'khor dbus gnas par/ /brtul zhugs can gyis laṃ las/ dbang chen bsgom | | dbang chen dkyil 'khor steng du ni/ /bdag nyid kyang ni yi ge 'bru gsum ho gnyis kyi bar du tshud par/ bsgom par bya/ /bruṃ las gnas 'khor lo de drug la sogs pa las gzhal yas khang*/ ni bsams nas su/ /rnam lha mo bco lnga'i gnas su pad+ma dang ro'i gdan de'i snying khar nyi mas mtshan pa bsams la byin gyis brlab pa'i sngags brjod/ pa mngon par byang chub pa| lnga ni rab brtag bya/ /yeshes lnga las byung ba yi/ /sems dpa'i gzugs rgyu rdo rje 'dzin pa/ brnyan phyag mtshan/ bsgom par bya/ /rdo rje sems dpa' las 'od du zhu ba las| byung ba'i/ /rig ma'i 'bras bu rdo rje 'dzin pa/ skyes bu bsgom par bya/ /oṃ dharma dhā tu badz+ra swa bhā ba āt+ma ko3 haṃ/ rdo rje gzhengs

rgyu rdo rje 'dzin pa 'od du zhu ba las glus bskul bas 'bras bu rdo rje 'dzin par/ pa zhes bya ba'i ting nge 'dzin to/ /mig 'bras bu rdo rje 'dzin pa de'i| la sogs pa gti mug sogs/ /rdo rje gsum ni gnas gsum dgod/ / thugs snying kha'i zla steng du hūm̐ las/ kyi rdo rje mkha' spyod ma/ / sngon mo/ gsung mgrin par zla steng du āḥlas/ gi rdo rje sa spyod ma/ / dmar mo/ sku la dpral bar zla steng du oṃ las/ zhabs 'og gnas pa ste/ / dkar mo/ hūm̐ āḥ.oṃ las byung ba'o/ / de yan chad he ru ka'i bstan/ rdo rje 'di man chad bdag med ma'i/ dkar mo chu bdag lha mo phyogs gang du dgod pa/ ma/ /rdo rje mkha' 'gro bdag med ma/ / yis/ zhe sdang rdo rje gnas mnan dbus kyi lte ba/ cing*/ / dkyil 'khor nang gi 'phar ma/ snying por lte ba/ bsgom par bya/ /dkar mo chom rkun ro langs ma/ /ghasma rī ni sgo srung ma/ /puk+ka sī dang rī khrod ma/ /gdol pa g.yung mo mtshams su dgod/ /steng du mkha' spyod ma zhes bshad/ /'og du de bzhin sa spyod ma/ /dbus su bdag med mkha' 'gro ma/ /mkha' 'gro dkyil 'khor nyid du bsgom/ /byang bdag med ma'i aṃ las 'od spros te dbang gi lha spyan drangs te gsol ba gdab pa/ chub rdo rje sangs rgyas shākya thub pa/ la/ /ji ltar chen po'i che stsal pa/ / ltar/ bdag kyang rab tu bskyab pa'i phyir/ /nam mkha'i rdo rje slob dpon gyi dbang*/ bdag la stsol/ /dbang bskur rdo rje chen po ni/ khams gsum gyis ni bdag po/ phyag byas pa/ /sangs rgyas sku gsung thugs/ kun gyi gsang ba gsum gyi/ /gnas las byung ba sbyin par bya zhes gsung*/ stsol bar mdzad/ /ye shes pa spyan drangs la/ kyi dbang bskur bar| la gsol ba gdab pa zhes bya ba'i ting nge 'dzin to/ /rig ma'i skyes bu'i dbang gi lha/ chen po/ la/ /cod gsol ba btab pas dbang bskur te/ pan la/ rang gi lhag pa'i lha/

/des ni dkyil 'khor la/ dbang bskur ba/ dang ni/ /bstod dang mchod pa la sogs khongs su bdud rtsi myang ba bsdu/ bya/ /ye shes kyi 'khor lo/ gzhug pa bya/ de bzhin yang | | sku gsung thugs brlab pa/ lce bdud rtsi byin gyis brlab pa sngar bstan/ yis rdo rje bdud rtsi myang*/ /nang du gtum mo bsgom pa kha bskang*/ brjod pa'i sbyor ba las/ /brtul zhugs can gyis sngags sngags kyi yi ge lte ba nas zhugs te rang gi khar bcug pa'i tshul gyis bskor| bzlas bya/ / ā li bco lnga/ rnal 'byor ma 'byung ba zhes bya ba'i le'u ste sho lo ka nyi shu rtsa drug dang rkang pa gcig go/ bcu gnyis pa'o// //de nas byams pa la sogs pa'i byang chub sems dpa' rnams kyis rang rang gi rnam par rtog pa skyes par gyur te/ bcom rnal 'byor ma rgyud ces bya ba ji ltar na rnal 'byor ma'i rgyud ces bya snyam na/ ldan 'das ji ltar na gur 'di la/ rnal 'byor ma'i rgyud ces ci ste/ bshad par bgyi/ rdo rje 'dzin pas bka' stsal pa/ gnyis su med pa'i ye shes rang bzhin lhan skyes/ shes rab pha rol phyin pa de'i/ 'i rten/ thabs/ / ni/bud med la rnal 'byor ma zhes mngon par brjod/ / pa de 'dir ston par byed pas 'dir dngos su dkyil 'khor gyi rang bzhin gyi lha mor ston/ phyag rgya dang thabs lhar bskyed pa gnyis/ phyag rgya chen po'i sbyor ba las/ /gang phyag rgya la brten nas lhan skyes/ phyir de nyid brten pa yi/ / phyir rgyud ces bya ste dngos su gzhan lus shes rab la brten nas lhan skyes mngon du byed pa'o// rnal 'byor ma yi rdo rje gur/ / 'di la rnal 'byor ma yi rgyud ces bshad/ / pha rol tu phyin pa byin po mi 'byung ngam zhe na/ pha rol phyin pa kun gyi thabs/ / de'i dus na ma chags pas sbyin pa/ nyes byas phra mos ma gos pas tshul khrims/ zhe sdang med pas bzod pa/ le lo med pas brtson 'grus/

ma yengs pas bsam gtan/ bsam phyi rol gyi bzlas pa la sogs pa la mi ltos te/ gtan tsam gyis 'grub par 'gyur/ /dga' mnyam sbyor/ mdzes 1ḍā ka2mkha' 'gro bde dang rgya mtsho bde dang nam mkha' dang*/ /gser gyi char pa dang ni dga' chen za nus dang*/ /bdai chen dgyes pa dang ni gsang ba yi bde dang*//rgyud de rnams la phan pa'i rdo rje mkha' 'gro dang*/ /sangs rgyas thams cad kye yi rdo rje'i dkyil 'khor dang*/ /gsang ba'i mdzod dang rdo rje bdud rtsi las byung dang*/ /'khor lo bde mchog gur gyi 'byung gnas ni// mkha' 'gro ( 1 ) bde ba'i mkha' 'gro rgya mtsho'i rgyud/ mtsho/ / ( 2 ) mkha' nam mkha' dang ( 3 ) mnyam pa'i rgyud/ dang ( 4 ) gser gyi char pa rdo rje gdan bzhi/ dang*/ /dga' zla gsang thig le nor bu/ chen ma ( 5 ) dang ghasma 'i rgyud/ rī/ / ( 6 ) shin tu dges rol ( 7 ) gsang yid 'phrog / ( 8 ) rdo rje mkha' 'gro gzhan la/ phan rgyud brgyad/ /kye yi rdo rje'i de bzhin gshegs pa'i dag pa/ dkyil 'khor sangs rgyas ( 1 ) kun/ / te rgyal ba lnga'i dkyil 'khor ston pa 'bum lnga/ gsang pa'i/ mdzod ( 2 ) rdo rje bdud rtsi 'byung ba dang*// ( 3 ) 'khor lo'i sdom pa ( 4 ) gur dang lnga/ gyi 'byung gnas ( 6 ) ni/ / he ru ka mngon par mtho ba'i rgyud/ rnal 'byor ma rgyud drug tu rab tu grags/ / gdul bya/ skyes bu rnams ni 'dul ba'i phyir/ /rnal 'byor rgyud ni yang dag bshad/ /btsun mo rnams ni bsdu ba'i phyir/ /rnal 'byor ma yi rgyud bshad do/ /dman phyi rol gyi ras bris sam lugs ma la sogs pa lhar dmigs pa dang gtsang sbra dang bsdam pa la sogs pa lhur spyod pa'i/ pa rgyud bzhi gang zag la bstan/ rnams la bya ba'i su sid+dhi ka ra legs pa ( grub pa ) dang*/ phyag na rdo rje dbang bskur ba dang*/ dpung bzangs kyis zhus pa la sogs pa/ rgyud/ /bya phyi rol ba dang nang gi ba rnal 'byor bdag las lha phyi rol du dmigs pa'i/

de ltag la/ / rnam par snang mdzad mngon par byang chub pa la sogs pa/ sems can rang gi lhag pa'i lha dang rang ro gcig tu dmigs pa'o// mchog la rnal 'byor ta ta saṃ gra ha sogs/ mchog /rnal ye shes sems dpa' dang dbyer med par bstims par 'dod/ 'byor gong med de ltag la/ /de nas byang chub sems dpa' rnams kyis bcom ldan 'das la gsol pa/ re zhig bdag cag gis rgyud gyi dgongs pa'i don/ yul rnams ni 'tshal na/ sems can gzhan rnams kyis ji ltar sangs rgyas kyi gsungs pa 'tshal ba lags/ te de'i dgongs pa ji ltar shes par bya ba'am ji ltar bsgom par bya zhes pa'o// bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa/ /stong rtog pa rang bzhin med pa shes rab/ pa snying rje tha dad dngos po sna tshogs bskyed pa'am sku la sogs pa bskyed pas thabs/ med/ /gang du sems ni rab bsgom thabs shes rab dbyer med du rtogs pa'i/ pa | | bsgom pa'i dus su yang sems nyid spros bral thabs shes dbyer med du shes par byas nas gang ltar yang mi sgom pa'i tshul gyis/ gnyis med/ de ni sangs rgyas dngos po rtogs pa/ chos dang ni// dge 'dun rtog pa las skyob pas thabs shes gnyis med kyi ngo bor 'dug pas/ gyi yang bstan pa'o | | mu gnyis med du rtogs pas/ stegs can sun bdag tu 'dzin pa/ dbyung ba dang*/ dngos por zhen pa/ rgol ba tshar bcad pa dang*/ rang gi sde pa'i gzhung stong pa dang snying rje dbyer med/ brjod pa zhes bya ba'i ting nge 'dzin to/ / gang zag gang gi don du bsgoms pa bstan| bdag gis de ltar dbyer med du bsgom pa'i dgos pa/ byang chub thob phyir dang*/ / gang phyir gzhan dag 'khor ba las/ bsgral ba'i phyir/ /des dngos po rtogs pa/ na sangs rgyas chos dang rtog pa 'dul bas/ ni/ /dge thabs shes gnyis med kyi ngo bor 'dus pas/ 'dun gyi yang bstan pa'o/ /bdag dgos pa gang gi don du bsgom pa bstan/ 'dzin gnyis kyi/

zhen pa bzlog pa'i phyir/ /chos thabs gang gis sgom pa/ dbyings bdag nyid gnyis med ye shes rdo rje 'dzin pa'i/ sgrub thabs ni/ / stong bzhin du sna tshogs su snang zhing skye ba/ thabs dang shes rab phan tshun dbyer med/ 'dus rang bzhin gyis mtshan ma dang bral ba'i rgyu'i rgyud/ pa yis/ / des ni sangs kyi/ rgyas bstan pa'o/ / sa'i snying po'ang de'o// de nas bcom ldan 'das rnams dang*/ rgyal ba'i sras po rnams bcom ldan 'das kyi gong ga ི gsung 'di thos nas thabs shes rab gnyis med kyi don bstan pa la/ dga' bar gyur te/ tshig 'di smras pa/ e ma kun tu bzang po ston pa ste stong pa dang snying rje dbyer med do// yi/ /bstan thabs shes rab gnyis med bstan pa'i snying po yin pas/ pa nam mkha' las byung ba/ /nam de lta bu'i ngo bor/ mkha'i gnas su nam mkha' ltar mi dmigs pa'i go 'phang la/ sbyor ba yis/ / ye shes rgya mtsho dang 'dra ba mnga' bar gsungs pa/ nyan par 'gyur/ / ro// de nas rdo rje 'dzin rgyal ni/ / 'dod pa'i yon tan bsten pa la brten nas/ bde ba chen po rnams rtogs pa gong nas gong du/ 'phel bas/ /dam 'da' bar mi bya bas/ tshig thams cad bshad par bya// sangs dgos ched/ rgyas 'bras bu 'dod pa yis/ /bde 'dod yon lnga bsten pa'i/ dang rangs shing gar dang ni/ /glu dang rol mo'i sgra byed pas/ /dri dang phreng ba byug pa yis | | rig pa'i rgyal po phyag rgya chen po/ rab tu 'grub/ /ji ltar rgyu lam gyi dus su/ bde bar 'bras bu yang*/ bde bzung nas/ /ji ltar bde bar/ 'dod par spyad par bya// ji ltar gnas 'dod yon go 'phang la/ su gnas nas kyang*/ /yi ge dam pa ak+ṣa ra mi 'gyur ba ste phyag rgya chen po/ 'grub par 'gyur/ /bza' rang ji ltar 'dod pa'i/ dang btung ba'i sbyor ba dang*/ /bzang po'i rgyan gyis brgyan pa yis/ /nyi ma gcig tu nyin gcig bzhin/ bskul ba 'dod pa bsten pa/ yis/ /dam pa'i de nyid 'grub par 'gyur//

rtag tu rang gi bza' ba'i/ dam tshig myang*/ /rtag tu de bzhin gshegs pa mchod/ / pa yang des/ rtag tu bla ma la yang dbul/ /bla de 'bul na/ ma sangs rgyas kun dang mnyam | | ji ltar sangs rgyas rnams dang mnyam zhe na/ mgon po rnam snang mdzad/ /rdo rje mi bskyod pa/ 'dzin bzhin bla ma nyid/ /de ltar rin 'byung*/ nam mkha' rgyal po che/ /ji ltar thub pa 'od dpag med/ rdo rje chos/ /ji ltar mgon po bdun don grub/ rgyal po// ji ltar rdo rje slob dpon de rnams dang mnyam par/ brjod/ /de bas 'bad pa thams cad kyis/ /rdo rje slob dpon bla ma che/ /dge ba mchog tu gsal ba po/ / nyams su len pa/ nam yang smad par mi bya'o/ /rdo rje sdom pa'i le'u ste sho lo ka nyi shu rtsa bzhi'o// bcu gsum pa'o// //de nas bcom ldan 'das rdo rje chen po gnyis su med pa'i ye shes mngon du byas pa/ rdo rje gsor bar bzhed pa/ mkha' 'gro ma bdag med mas 'khyud pas/ bzang po de ni sgrub thabs so// spyod pa dbye ni lus la sogs pa'i dngos grub bo// bar bya/ / 'o// rdo he ru ka'i| rje'i gang gis rig 'dzin sgrub pa de'i rnal 'byor du bya/ gzugs su bzhag nas ni/ /ji ltar rnam par snang mdzad mi bskyod pa la sogs pa'i rig 'dzin sgrub par/ 'dod pa'i 'dod pa yis | | rig 'dzin drug gi rnal 'byor la brten te 'grub pas/ 'khor los sgyur ba yis/ / dogs 'grub bam mi 'grub snyam pa'i/ pa med par 'grub par 'gyur/ / ba bstan/mi bskyod pa'i rnal 'byor gyis gnyis/ dri bshad/ lnga bdud rtsi lnga'am gur gum sogs/ yang dag blangs nas su | | rdzas sha lnga/ lnga dang ni bsre bar bya/ /lcags gser dngul zangs/ gsum gyis ni dkris nas ni/ /ri mi snang ba'i dngos grub/ lu'i rig pa 'dzin par 'gyur/ / rgyu/ gur gum a ga ru dang cha mnyam par bsres pa dang*/ ldan pa/ /nyi ma dmar ser/ 'char ka'i mdog 'dra ba'i/ /ri lu kha ru bcug byas nas/

/nyi tshe nyi zla gnas kyi bar du/ ma'i rig pa 'dzin par rin 'byung gi yin/ 'gyur/ /sha 'di la nyi ma'i/ lnga gong ma gnyis kyi steng du/ dang ni ldan pa ru/ /lcags gsum gyis ni dkris nas ni/ /rdo rje nyi ma 'i rnal 'byor la gnas te/ rab sbyor bas/ /nyi ma gcig gis tshe/ 'grub par 'gyur/ /tsan+dan dmar po kha che gur gum dang*/ /dga' byang pa tsha 'tshong gi sha ba sbas pa sbrang ma'i gcin dang sbyang byas te zer/ sbyar pa ni/ /lcags gsum gyis ni dkris byas pa/ /rta yi rig pa don grub/ 'dzin par 'gyur/ /'jig rten mgon po 'od dpag med/ rnam par/ bsgoms nas | | tsa sran ma/ na ka 'i rus pa'i tshad tsam las/ /gu rgyu/ gul las byas pa'i/ lcags gsum/ kyis dkris pa ni/ /mgon po'i 'od dpag med/ rig pa tshe 'dzin par 'gyur// ri lu sgrub thabs rdo rje zhes bya ba'i ting nge 'dzin to// // klu sbrul mgo gnyis pa/ yi rgyal po'i mgo kham phor kha sbyar du/ bsregs nas// rang sih+la/ byung khrag gis bsgo bar bya/ /rdo de mig la byugs na/ rje phan pa'i rnal 'byor gyis | | mig 'jig rten gsum mthong ba'i dngos grub/ sman rig pa 'dzin par 'gyur/ / ba bla'i sa bon ldan pa dang*/ /stag gi lpags pa'i tshil bu mnye/ /sku yi rdo rje'i rnal 'byor gyis/ /rkang pa'i byug pa rkang mgyogs/ 'grub par 'gyur/ /yan snang ba mtha' yas/ lag med pa'i ma ga dhā yi yul gyi dbus zer/ dkyil 'khor dbus/ / su 'dug dbang lha'i dbang pos bcom ldan 'das la phul ba rdo rje gdan gyi shar na yod/ po'i brag phug 'gram du ni/ /rdo rje rkang 'og gnod mdzes kyi/ rnal 'byor gyis/ /lha 'dod khams kyi| yi bu mo rab bsgrub bya/ / nub u rgyan/ o ḍ+yan yul du nye ba na/ /a mra chen po skye ba| 'i ri la ni/ /rdo rje rang*/ gnod mdzes sbyor ba yis/ / lha min mo// rkang lha'i bu mo'i bre brag 'og rig pa 'dzin par 'gyur/

/rdo rje sems gnod mdzes rang la bya ba'am yang na rdo rje sems dpa' gnod mdzes kyi spyi bor dbu brgyan par bsgom pa'o// dpa' rgyal po rang nyid bsgoms nas gsung*/ che/ /yang nas yang du mdun du gnas pa la bka' bgo ba/ bskul bar bsgom/ bya/ /de nyid dngos grub thams cad kyi/ / sgrubs pas dper na/ yid bzhin nor bu lta bur mtshungs/ /rdo rje gnod mdzes sku chen po/ /phyag gnyis zhal ni gcig pa can/ sdigs mdzub klu yi zhags pa can/ kha dog nag po bsgom par bya/ /rdo rje chen po 'dzin pa/ mdzod ni blangs g.yas na ral gri nges 'dzin par/ zer| nas ni/ /rnam pa thams cad ye shes pa dgug gzhug bya ba dang sku gsung thugs byin gyis brlab pa dang dbang bskur/ bsgom par bya/ /mi bskyod pa yis dbu/ yang dag mnan/ / hūm̐ phu hūm̐/

zhes bya ba'i sngags brjod do/ /rab tu byug pa dang mig sman rdo rje zhes bya ba'i ting nge 'dzin to// //de nas de bzhin gshegs pa de rnams thams cad bcom ldan 'das kyi gsung thos nas/ dga' zhing mgu ba skyes par gyur te/ tshig 'di dag smras so// e ma'o sku/ rdo rje e ma gsung rdo rje/ /e ma'o thugs/ rdo rje'i sgo nas ngo mtshar ba/ bstan pa ni | | chos rigs pas dpyad na/ rnams thams cad stong pa la/ / rang bzhin gyis 'od gsal bas| kun rdzob tu/ gang phyir dngos grub kyi rgyu 'bras/ rab tu/ gnas pa/ / dper na/ snying po med pa'i chu shing la/ /ji ltar snying po'i 'bras zhim pa/ /de ltar 'byung ba/ snying po med pa'i/ lus la/ /dngos grub kyi/ 'bras bu/ zhim po 'byung ba yang*/ de bzhin no/ / de ngo mtshar ba'o/ / nam dpe de'i don gzhan yang sems skye ba med pa la du mar snang bar bstan/ mkha' ni dngos po med kyang 'gro ba lnga po/ 'byung po thams cad dang*/ /chos snod bcud/ rnams kun gyi gnas yin te/ /sems ni nam mkha' lta bur dag /dag rang bzhin gyis mtshan ma las| pa'i sems ni mchog tu bde/ /don yul/ dang dbang po'i rang bzhin gyis/ / sems de yang glo bur du yang nyid snang yang dngos po la/ las phyi rol gyur pa med/ / gzugs sogs so sor 'dod pa yis/ /sems nyid du ni 'dod par bya/ /de nas byang chub sems dpa' phyag na rdo rjes bcom ldan 'das la gsol pa/ bcom ldan 'das de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad ji ltar na chos thams cad sems kyi ngo bor bsdus pa las skye ba med pa'i ngo bo/ sems stong pa'i sems sems stong pa lags la phyi rol gyi don mi stong pa lags na/ las phyi rol gyi sems don zer snang*/ mi stong pa rab tu 'byung zhes bgyi/ de sems las byung ba zhes ci'i phyir bgyi zer/ bzhin gshegs pas bka' stsal pa/ /thog med srid pa'i rim pa yis zer/ bag chags kyis/ /phyi rol don
